#548. No, We Aren’t All Eating 'Too Much' Protein

📅 05 Nov 2026

No, We Aren’t All Eating 'Too Much' Protein

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/can-you-eat-too-much-protein?utm_medium=RSS

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’ll permit me a rant—i promise to make it fact-filled and interesting—i am sick of the articles that seem to pop up every few months claiming that we are all eating “too much” protein. They convey an inaccurate picture of how the body uses protein, and they demonize perfectly healthy meals that happen to be high in protein. It’s time to set the record straight.

Berdasarkan laporan, it is true that most of us eat more than the rda (recommended daily allowance) of protein, but that's a good thing—the rda is meant as a minimum. It's also true that you can eat a healthy diet with little to no meat, but meat is not synonymous with protein. It's true that protein-boosted foods are trendy, and that they're not necessarily great dietary choices in the big picture. Let's look at what we actually know about the role of protein in a healthy diet, and how to tell if you're eating too much or too little.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a refresher, protein is one of the three calorie-containing macronutrients (fats, carbs, protein) that make up most of the food we eat. Proteins are made of amino acids, and these amino acids are required for the growth, repair, and functioning of our bodies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we can get protein from a variety of sources. Plant-based foods tend to have less protein than animal products, but it’s not hard to meet or exceed protein requirements even on a vegan diet. Meats are particularly protein-dense; a chicken breast contains about 35 grams of protein. Other animal products, like milk and eggs, are also rich in protein. Beans, grains, and soy products like tofu contain significant amounts of protein, for example.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’d like a cheat sheet on how much protein you’re supposed to eat based on your activity level, you can find one here. And that’s a good place to start dissecting this “too much protein” myth, because before we can declare an amount of protein to be “too much,” we need to understand how much is “enough. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the government communicates targets for different nutrients to encourage us all to eat a healthy, balanced diet. These targets are the basis for the “% daily value” labels on the back of packaged foods, and for the nutrient makeup of school lunches. The RDA, or recommended daily allowance, is defined as “the average daily dietary intake level that is sufficient to meet the nutrient requirement of nearly all (97 to 98 percent) healthy individuals in a group. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in other words, if 100% of us were to eat the rda of protein, at least 97% of us would be getting enough protein—we'd be meeting the minimum to be healthy. That's right, this number is a minimum to avoid malnutrition, not a maximum, and not a recommendation for optimal health.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by the way, if you're wondering how that number is determined? for protein, it is based on nitrogen balance. If you eat enough protein (which contains nitrogen), the amount of nitrogen you excrete will be the same as, or more than, the amount you eat. Humans break down proteins, as part of our body’s daily function, and we excrete nitrogen as a result. In other words, if you aren’t breaking your own body proteins down (in excess of what you eat), then whatever you’re eating must be, in some sense, enough.

Berdasarkan laporan, in this way of thinking, the rda is the minimum to stay healthy. For some nutrients, there is also an UL, or upper limit, telling you that more than a certain amount is too much. More is fine; less would mean that you may not be getting enough. Upper limits are calculated for vitamins and minerals; there is no upper limit defined for protein.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, therefore, there is no official definition for “too much” protein. If somebody eats more than the RDA, they’re not eating too much; they’re just eating more than the minimum. You’re supposed to eat more than the minimum.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rda for protein is set at 46 grams per day for a 125-pound woman, and at 56 grams per day for a 154-pound man. 8 grams of protein per kilogram bodyweight, which works out to 0. (The USDA chose those as their examples. ) That’s based on an RDA of 0. 36 grams per pound. So a 200-pound person would need 72 grams of protein per day.

Berdasarkan laporan, this usda report found that most adult men average roughly 90 to 100 grams of protein per day, although men aged 70 and up only get about 80 grams of protein per day. Women tend to average around 70 grams per day, with those aged 70 and up averaging 62 grams.

Sebagaimana diketahui, above the rda? yes. Too much? I don’t see any way of arguing that. On the other hand, the averages for what we eat are based on actual people, not ideals. And before you say that we’re getting almost double the recommendation, let's check the math. The average American man is 200 pounds, and the average American woman is 171 pounds. Those RDA numbers are for 125- and 154-pound people. So, to compare the numbers:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the average woman is 171 pounds, so her rda would be 62 grams per day. (Women, on average, eat 70 grams of protein per day. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the average man is 200 pounds, so his rda would be 72 grams per day. (Men, on average, eat 90 to 100 grams of protein per day. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, again, there’s no need to stick to the minimum; going 8 grams over, or even 28 grams over, is fine. It’s probably better to go over than to just scrape by, and many of us arguably don’t get enough. Let me explain.

Diungkapkan bahwa let’s start with older adults. Not only does protein intake tend to decrease with age, older adults are vulnerable to issues that stem from a loss of muscle mass. People tend to lose 3-5% of their muscle mass per decade starting at age 30, but strength training and protein intake can support maintaining our muscle, and thus likely prevent or reduce that decline.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the dietary guidelines include a note that “about 50 percent of women and 30 percent of men 71 and older fall short of protein foods recommendations. ” Meanwhile, a study found that older adults who don’t meet the recommendations are “more likely to be limited when stooping, crouching, or kneeling, standing or sitting for long periods, walking up 10 steps, preparing meals, and walking for a quarter mile. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so even if it’s true that the average adult gets more protein than recommended, there are clearly a lot of elderly folks who don’t. These are the same people who have more issues functioning in everyday life. This may be a chicken-and-egg situation—was the functional decline a cause or an effect of the change in their diet?—but this sure does not seem to be a group of people who should be eating less protein.

Diungkapkan bahwa there’s another large group of people who benefit from more, not less, protein: people who are pregnant or lactating. Instead of 0. 36 grams of protein per pound of body weight (62 grams for a 171-pound person), the RDA for people who are pregnant or lactating is 0. 5 grams/pound (so, 86 grams of protein per day).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you’re pregnant, you also have higher caloric needs, so the increased total amount of food makes it easier to get the higher protein amount. Still, it makes more sense to spend your energy on making sure you’re getting enough protein, rather than worrying about getting too much.

You knew we were heading in this direction (I say between reps of barbell squats, wiping protein shake off my lips): People who exercise should get more protein than just the RDA.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the fear-mongering “too much protein” articles sometimes mention that bodybuilders or elite athletes need their protein, they tend to hand-wave this away as a special concern that doesn’t apply to normal people. But I think it’s worth a closer look—and honestly, this situation applies to a lot more people than just a few athletes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, officially, there isn’t an rda for athletes; people who exercise can stave off malnutrition with the same 0. 36 grams per pound as everyone else. But that doesn’t mean that the RDA is the best target to aim for.

Berdasarkan laporan, the international association of athletics federations, which governs track and field competitions, recommends that most athletes who are maintaining or gaining weight eat 0. 59 to 0. 77 grams of protein per pound of bodyweight per day. That’s 101 to 131 grams for the average 171-pound woman, and 118 to 154 grams for a 200-pound man.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a group of organizations, including the american college of sports medicine, largely agrees, recommending a range from 0. 9 grams per pound for all athletes whose weight is stable or gaining. 54 to 0. That includes people who do endurance training like distance running, as well as strength athletes whose exercise involves mainly lifting weights. Those ranges would go as high as 153 grams for our 171-pound woman, and 180 grams for our 200-pound man.

Berdasarkan laporan, you don’t need to be an olympian to consider yourself an “athlete” in this sense. If you’re training for a half marathon, you’re doing plenty of distance running, and should fuel accordingly. And if you’re “just” lifting weights in the gym, but taking it seriously enough that you’re training regularly and working hard, you should consider eating in these ranges as well.

Berdasarkan laporan, dieting to lose weight is not only a popular american pastime, it’s also arguably good for at least some people's health. If you’ve been on a diet recently, or if you’re planning to go on one, you aren’t a person who should settle for the RDA either.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, research shows that protein intake (and strength training—they go together!) is important to maintain muscle mass when we’re losing weight. After all, you’re aiming for fat loss, not trying to get your muscles to waste away. Muscle loss is especially a concern with weight-loss drugs like Ozempic, but any dieter should be aware of this issue.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, this study found that diets ranging from 0. 48 to 0. 72 grams of protein per kg of body weight (that’s 82 to 123 grams for our 171-pound woman, 96 to 144 for our 200-pound man) resulted in less weight regain after the diet, and helped people to maintain muscle mass and feel more full while they were dieting.

Diungkapkan bahwa and if you’re losing weight and exercising? the iaaf recommends that athletes who are “undertaking high-quality weight loss” need at least 0. Most people won’t need to go that high, and it’s unclear whether athletes need to go that high. 09 grams per pound. That would be 186 grams for a 171-pound athlete, or 218 grams for a 200-pound athlete. 72 grams per pound of bodyweight, and possibly as much as 1. But I’m including these numbers so you see how high the ranges actually go.

Berdasarkan laporan, ultimately, weight loss is widely understood to be more effective and have healthier results with higher protein intakes rather than lower ones. When people focus on just eating less, without thinking about what their diet actually consists of, it’s easy to forget about protein. But the evidence suggests that you should increase protein when you’re decreasing overall calories.

The idea that protein causes weight gain is a common talking point in those articles about “too much” protein, and it’s sort of true—but it also doesn’t mean what you think it means.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you eat more food than your body needs, your body can store it as fat. That’s true no matter what the excess is made of—protein, carbs, fat, or even alcohol. The protein you eat gets used for many different things in your body. You can build it into muscle tissue, use it for growth and repair of different kinds of cells, and so on. You can also use it for energy—basically, burning it for the calories.

So if you were eating a perfectly balanced diet, and then decided to add an extra 100 grams of protein per day, then sure, a lot of that protein would be used for energy, and since we’d have excess energy, it would get stored as fat.

Diungkapkan bahwa but if you ate more protein, but that protein replaced other foods in your diet, then there would be no excess calories to store. Nobody is saying you should chug a couple of protein shakes on top of your regular diet. They’re saying (I’m saying) that you should plan your meals and snacks to include more protein.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, if your regular lunch is a turkey-and-cheese sandwich with a side of chips, you could improve the protein content of your diet by adding more turkey to the sandwich and replacing the chips with an apple. Same total calories, but more protein. As long as your total calories for the day aren’t in excess of your needs, the “extra” protein won’t get stored as fat.

Berdasarkan laporan, in general, high protein diets don’t have any serious health consequences. There’s a major exception, though: in some medical conditions, you may be told to limit your protein intake to protect your health.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for example, people with chronic kidney disease are often advised to use the rda (0. 36 grams per pound of body weight) as a maximum rather than a minimum. Your kidneys play a role in processing protein for excretion, so a lowered protein intake reduces the amount of work that a damaged kidney has to do. That said, once a person with chronic kidney disease begins dialysis, they may be advised to increase their protein intake for better health now that their body has help to handle the higher levels.

Berdasarkan laporan, people with certain other disorders, like phenylketonuria and homocystinuria, may also be advised to eat a low-protein diet. Obviously, if you have one of these conditions, you should be getting your dietary advice from your medical team (ask for a referral to a dietitian!) rather than from general articles on the internet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, besides those known medical issues, the occasional findings about eating “too much” protein tend to fit into the “x is good for you/x is bad for you” ricochet news cycle. They’re not holistic assessments of protein in general on health in general, but rather specific research questions that are still being figured out.

Berdasarkan laporan, for example, this 2017 study found that a high-protein (and high-fiber) diet seemed to slightly worsen one measure of insulin resistance, but it also improved metabolic health and body composition. The researchers concluded that the subjects’ body chemistry was probably just responding appropriately to the changed nutrient content of their diet. A few years later, a study of high-BMI women with insulin resistance saw improvements to their insulin resistance on a high-protein diet.

Diungkapkan bahwa or to take another example, a study in 2024 found a link between high-protein diets and atherosclerosis. But if you look at what the researchers were actually studying, they were looking at how leucine (one amino acid found in protein) affects the mTOR biochemical pathway in certain types of white blood cells. By the way, that mTOR pathway is involved in a lot more body processes than atherosclerosis, and does a lot of good things too.

Berdasarkan laporan, so are these results interesting, and worth further study? definitely. Worth changing protein recommendations? Only if this effect turns out (1) to actually lead to worse health outcomes, and (2) to outweigh the known benefits of higher protein. The body of evidence doesn’t yet support lowering protein recommendations, nor adding an upper limit.

So if protein is good for us, and most of us can’t really get “too much,” why are so many people arguing that we’re overdoing it? I think part of the reason is just misunderstanding (the writers don’t tend to have a background in nutrition and especially not in sports nutrition), but more often, I think they’re talking about a different issue entirely.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, often the “too much protein” stuff is just a way of talking about the environmental effects of meat consumption or dairy farming. People making this argument are trying to pry the double cheeseburgers out of our hands and reassure us that we’ll be okay. I don’t think an attack on protein is an appropriate way to make that point, since plant-based proteins exist and are a fine alternative. But I understand where they’re coming from.

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, if you’re trying to make the argument that we’re eating “too much” protein for our health, you really can’t do that without some evidence that we’re eating so much protein that it’s harming our health on a widespread level. And that evidence just doesn’t exist.

GameStop, of course, will happily take your PS5 off your hands, but it doesn't seem as generous as BackMarket. For one, that BackMarket deal is live for anyone. #558. Windows Laptops Just Closed a Major Gap With the MacBook Neo

📅 05 Nov 2026

Windows Laptops Just Closed a Major Gap With the MacBook Neo

Tanggal: 05 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/windows-laptops-just-closed-a-major-gap-with-the-macbook-neo?utm_medium=RSS

Berdasarkan laporan, to say the macbook neo disrupted the laptop market would be an understatement. When the Neo dropped, former Apple CEO Tim Cook said Apple had its best-ever launch week for first-time Mac customers, and the company is reportedly planning on doubling the MacBook's sales for 2027. It's not hard to see why the MacBook Neo is such a hit: Apple is offering the essential Mac experience at a fantastic price point. You no longer need to spend $1,000 or more for a MacBook, so long as you're okay making some sacrifices to get there—which, it seems, many customers are.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the macbook neo has been a boon for apple and apple fans alike, i can only imagine the stress it brought to pc manufacturers—especially those with budget or midrange machines. While MacBooks have their passionate customers, buyers looking for the best value have had to weigh expensive Apple laptops against many far cheaper options from companies like Dell, HP, ASUS, and Lenovo. Windows PCs have long won the price war against Apple. But with the Neo, suddenly a MacBook was competing in this space, and well.

Berdasarkan laporan, part of the issue for pc manufacturers was apple's control over its own ecosystem. You might be comparing the MacBook Neo against a Windows laptop with similar specs, or even better specs, but because Microsoft makes Windows, not the laptop manufacturer, it's possible the Neo ends up with the better overall experience. Unlike most PC makers, which only produce the hardware for each machine, Apple makes both the hardware and the software for its MacBook lineup. It can design macOS to run more efficiently on weaker hardware, in a way that companies like Dell or ASUS can't. As such, the company has the advantage of optimizing that hardware. While that might still be the case, Microsoft may have just closed that gap in a meaningful way.

Berdasarkan laporan, this week, microsoft announced key upgrades to memory-management efficiency, particularly for machines with 8gb of ram. This is the amount of memory the MacBook Neo has, as well as many budget and midrange Windows laptops. That's not much memory for 2026, regardless of platform, but Apple seems to have squeezed a lot out of it for the Neo. Now, Microsoft may have just done the same for PCs, as Windows is reportedly 20% more responsive, with 40% faster multitasking.

Diungkapkan bahwa in its blog post, microsoft highlighted improvements that users with 8 gb of ram can expect from windows going forward. As you use your PC, Windows used to move more of your apps and tabs to your drawer to free up more RAM for other things, meaning you'd need to reload those items whenever you returned to them. Going forward, the company says that Windows can keep up to 2GB more of your active data in RAM instead of moving it to slower storage elsewhere. First, Microsoft says it focused on better utilizing the RAM your machine already has. The company compares its memory management to a desk: Anything on the "desk" is stored in RAM; anything in your "drawer" is stored in your drive. That means apps and tabs should refresh less frequently when you leave and return to them.

Diungkapkan bahwa microsoft also says that small actions should be faster across the board. Microsoft Edge may open up to 33% faster, while Teams can enable Efficiency Mode by default on 8 GB machines, which means it can launch up to 20% faster too. It opened 20 tabs in Edge, a 4K video, large Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files, then Outlook and File Explorer, all without closing any windows. When you open the Start menu, search across your PC, right-click, open Settings, launch the Snipping Tool, and open File Explorer, those actions may be up to 20% faster than they were in January. Microsoft put together an interesting stress test to compare multitasking performance between today and January. That experience was 40% faster following this latest update.

Diungkapkan bahwa microsoft says it also improved the memory efficiency in its apps: the company claims it reduced committed-memory growth by up to 900 mb, and saved up to 360 mb in ram across word, powerpoint, excel, and outlook. That extends to third-party apps as well: Microsoft says that WhatsApp has double-digit memory improvement now. Widgets also only load when you open the app, which saves 200 MB of RAM when the app is closed, while Edge tabs go inactive after 15 minutes instead of two hours.

Diungkapkan bahwa microsoft isn't making these upgrades in a vacuum. Hardware costs, particularly for RAM, have skyrocketed in the age of AI. Microsoft knows that people are likely going to hold onto existing hardware for longer than they usually do, or that they'll opt for less-expensive configurations, including, perhaps, machines with 8 GB of RAM.

Berdasarkan laporan, pcmag's chris hoffman was adamant before this latest windows update that buyers should steer clear of pcs with 8 gb of ram. Now, he's pulling back a bit. In his testing, Hoffman noticed improvements when multitasking on an 8 GB PC when compared to similar tests from months ago. He could run multiple Chrome tabs, a Microsoft Word window, and Spotify without bogging down the computer much. Hoffman isn't a lightweight user, so he still wouldn't personally choose an 8 GB machine, but he admits, "If I were an average PC buyer looking for a reasonable desktop experience and could save hundreds of dollars by opting for 8GB of RAM, I might be happy with the performance. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa to that point, i think this new windows update makes 8 gb pcs competitive, especially against the macbook neo. We'll still need direct comparisons to know how well this new Windows experience holds up across the board, but these updates are promising. Users with 8 GB machines just got a free, valuable update overnight; new customers can opt for a more affordable PC without feeling like performance will take a nosedive just because they opened one too many Edge tabs.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as hoffman says, 8 gb of ram is not ideal for any user looking for serious multitasking or professional workflows, regardless of whether they choose a mac or pc. After all, Apple has slowly raised its price, too, from $599 to $699. If you're platform-agnostic, or even prefer Windows to macOS, these updates from Microsoft are quite promising. But for the average computer customer looking for a solid machine without breaking the bank, I no longer see the Neo as necessarily the default choice. If you're in the market, check out PCMag's excellent list of budget laptop recommendations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you're an android user looking for a way to save your photos and videos without maxing out your cloud storage space, your device may soon be able to back up automatically to your pc. As spotted by Android Authority, Google included automatic backups from Android to Windows via Quick Share in its release notes for Google Play services v26. 43.

Diungkapkan bahwa quick share is a wireless file-sharing feature for android that allows users to send photos, videos, and documents to nearby devices, including windows computers and iphones with airdrop. The new automatic backup feature, which is likely to roll out gradually, uses Quick Share's functionality to transfer copies of photos and videos on your phone to your PC when nearby.

Berdasarkan laporan, since these backups happen locally, you don't need to rely solely on cloud storage in your google account, nor do you need to remember to initiate transfers of photos and videos between devices. Plus, this is all free and doesn't require a separate cloud service subscription. While you can back up your media to Google Photos, as of earlier this year, more data from your Android backups count toward your Google Account storage cap unless you exclude specific types. Alternatively, you can also cobble together a decent amount of cloud storage from other providers at no extra cost, but automatic backups between Android and Windows minimize the likelihood that you'll forget to save data, and your PC provides plenty of space for free.

Diungkapkan bahwa once the feature is available on your device, you'll be able to initiate backups in the quick share for windows app. Your Android and Windows devices must be in close proximity and signed into the same Google Account. You can toggle Automatic backups on and change the settings for what gets backed up and to where. The transfers will then occur wirelessly in the background.

As Android Authority reports, early hints at this feature suggested that Samsung phones and PCs would be excluded from automatic backups, but the release notes don't specify any further details.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what better way to unwind than to close the door and dip into a warm bath, shutting all other distractions out. A physical book is great, until wet fingers cause ink to bleed or it slips into the water and gets totally waterlogged. If the bath has become your dedicated reading time, then it's about time to get an e-reader. But an e-reader — a waterproof one, specifically — can save the day.

These are the tech, tools, and products — from laptops to e-readers, from earbuds to robovacs, and more — that Mashable ranks best in class.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i remember the days when if you dropped your phone in a puddle, you put it in a bag of rice and prayed for the best. Luckily, tech has been waterproofed in recent years, so now your phone and tablet are safe if they get a little wet. E-readers have also been waterproofed, with many holding an IPX8 rating. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but not all e-readers are waterproof, and it's important to know which ones are before you take one to the bath. So if you're buying an e-reader and plan to be a bath time reader, these are the e-readers to look at.

And if you want the most luxurious experience, we recommend checking out e-reader accessories, too.

Read our review of the Kobo Libra Colour.

Sebagaimana diketahui, someone who wants the ultimate waterproof e-reader: among all of the waterproof e-readers we've tested, the best one for reading in the bath is the kobo libra colour. It has an IPX8 waterproof rating, which means it can be submerged in two meters of water for up to 60 minutes — but so do all of the e-readers on this list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the reason it's our favorite is that it has page-turn buttons, meaning you don't have to tap the screen with wet hands. With an extended edge, it has a great grip for a secure hold to make sure that it doesn't slip into the tub.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you were to ask me which e-reader to buy, it's a real toss-up between the kindle paperwhite and the kobo libra colour. While the Kobo Libra Colour is expensive at $259. 99, it's worth its price tag for all its included features.

Diungkapkan bahwa above all, the kobo libra colour has the best ergonomic design. This makes it easier to hold, especially while lying down and reading one-handed. It's one of the few e-readers to have an internal gyroscope, so when you rotate the device, the display rotates with it. It's more square than a Kindle, as one side offers extra space for page-turning buttons. While reading in bed, if I flipped over, I could rotate the device to still be able to hold it on the side with page-turning buttons.

Berdasarkan laporan, the overdrive (aka libby) integration is great, as you can log in with your library card, and your borrowed e-books instantly populate on the overdrive tab. While this is a more seamless integration than Kindle, I do have some minor beef with it. On a Kobo, you can only log in to one library card at a time, so if you borrow using multiple cards, you might be signing in and out of different accounts often. Plus, while using the Kobo Libra Colour, one of the library books I borrowed wasn't available on it, and I had to switch to the Paperwhite to be able to access the book.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the color display on the kobo is nice, it is still rather muted. While reading Heartstopper, the colors were quite toned down in comparison to how they appeared on the iPad mini. The Libra Colour's battery life isn't as strong as a Kindle Paperwhite's. While testing the Kobo Libra Colour over 10 weeks, my colleague Bethany Allard had to charge the device twice. Plus, it's a bit slower than a Kindle, with the occasional stall while switching between books.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the kindle may have the kobo beat on processing and battery life, i still think the libra colour is a worthy upgrade, as it offers the best design of an e-reader with the perk of color. 99, so at $259. Amazon's first color e-reader, the Colorsoft, costs $289. 99, the Libra is a little cheaper.

Read our review of the 2026 Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition.

Diungkapkan bahwa dedicated kindle users who need a waterproof e-reader: amazon users have a few options for waterproof kindles. The Paperwhite, Paperwhite Signature Edition, Colorsoft, and Colorsoft Signature Edition all have IPX8 ratings, so which should you go for?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the paperwhite signature edition is your best bet for reading in the bath. It's compatible with the new page-turn cover, so you can turn the page without tapping the screen. Or better yet, pair it with the Kindle Click and a stand so you don't have to hold it at all.

Diungkapkan bahwa the 2026 kindle paperwhite signature edition dethrones the 2024 kindle paperwhite as the best overall e-reader. With a new aluminum case, the Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition feels like a high-end piece of tech. Historically, I've preferred the Paperwhite, finding that the Signature Edition doesn't have enough features to justify its price, but the 2026 Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition finally fixes that. With a thinner body and square edges, this new Kindle feels more like a smartphone or tablet than it does an e-reader.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but inside the more advanced chassis is still the same e-reader you love. It's fast with a high-contrast 300 ppi resolution. The matte display is glare-free and easy on the eyes. With adjustable warmth and brightness, you can read with it in bright summer sun at the beach and then turn it down and warm it up when you're in a dim bedroom. And speaking of the beach, its IPX8 rating makes it safe to use in the bath or at the pool.

Diungkapkan bahwa it is a more expensive e-reader at $249. 99, especially compared to the Paperwhite's $199. 99, but here's what you get for an extra $50. The upgraded aluminum casing makes that $50 nearly worth it compared to the plastic exterior of the Paperwhite, but the Signature Edition also has an ad-free lockscreen, 32GB of storage compared to the Paperwhite's 16GB, wireless charging, auto-adjusting brightness, and best of all, compatibility with the new Kindle Page Turn Cover.

Berdasarkan laporan, plus, the kindle paperwhite signature edition comes in more exciting color options. While the Paperwhite just comes in graphite, the Signature Edition also comes in a stunning seaglass green.

Berdasarkan laporan, don't get us wrong, though; we still love the kindle paperwhite. If you want to save $50, the next best e-reader you can buy is the basic Kindle Paperwhite. It's still a quick, well-rounded e-reader but doesn't come in fun colors and has lockscreen ads.

Read our review of the Kobo Clara Colour.

Diungkapkan bahwa you want a cheap, waterproof e-reader: the cheapest waterproof e-reader is the kobo clara. 99, while the color model is $179. 99. It has an IPX8 rating, so you don't need to fear if it slips into the bath. The black and white version is $159. I wish it had page-turn buttons, but you could also use it with the Kobo Remote if you want to avoid touching the screen.

Berdasarkan laporan, having tried my hand at more than a dozen e-readers in all shapes, sizes, and brands, i wasn't expecting to be so deeply impressed by the kobo clara colour, but it is a wonderful e-reader. With a 6-inch screen, it's slightly smaller than the Kindle Paperwhite, but its size allows you to hold it comfortably for multiple hours at a time without any wrist or arm fatigue.

Berdasarkan laporan, in my previous testing with kobo devices, i've really liked them, but one sticking point is that they're slower than kindles. Initially, I found that the Kobo Clara kept up with the Paperwhite, but after several months of use, it had a tendency to lag. Compared to Kindles, I had to manually sync the Kobo Clara to get my library books to show up.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, its processing system is otherwise really smart and fixes one of my biggest e-reader pet peeves. When you adjust the font size on a Kindle, the device doesn't recalculate how many pages are in the book, making it inaccurate, so you don't know exactly how many pages you have left in a chapter. The Kobo Clara does recalculate page count accurately for a more exact reading experience. Though, one thing to note: Kobo counts the number of digital pages, whereas Kindle page numbers typically match up with physical book copies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for a lower price than the kindle paperwhite, the kobo clara offers color displays, something you can't get in the kindle lineup unless you're willing to spend $290. The colors aren't as bright as you'd experience in a physical book, but they're still vivid enough to enjoy a graphic novel.

Berdasarkan laporan, its libby (aka overdrive) integration is seamless, and e-books you borrow on your library card will automatically populate on your account. You can browse and borrow library books directly from the e-reader, instead of having to whip out your phone app. However, for users who use Libby to the max with multiple library cards, be warned: you can only log in to one account at a time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the kobo clara's biggest downfall is its battery life. It's supposed to last up to 42 days, although many online users say it averages out at about two weeks. That's quite pathetic in the face of the Kindle's 12-week battery life; however, I'd trade in a better reading experience over a couple weeks of battery life any day.

Berdasarkan laporan, no, not all e-readers are waterproof. All of the e-readers in this guide are waterproof, with an IPX8 rating. That means the device can be fully submerged in two meters of water without harm to the device.

But if you're looking at e-readers like the basic Kindle or e-readers from Boox, be cautious before using them near water, as none of these e-readers have waterproof ratings.

Berdasarkan laporan, yes, with their ipx8 rating, these e-readers can be fully submerged in water. However, there's a limit to the water exposure. The devices can only be submerged up to two meters for up to 60 minutes.

So if your e-reader falls into the bath, pick it up as soon as possible, dry it off, and shake off as much water as possible.

Diungkapkan bahwa all of these e-readers are tested using the same criteria as every e-reader we test. In addition to analyzing the devices' performance and value, we prioritized waterproof rating and special features.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this guide, we only included e-readers with waterproof ratings, knowing that if you're reading in the bath, it will definitely be exposed to water. The devices had to have an IPX8 rating, which makes them safe to be submerged in water.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we prioritized e-readers with page-turn buttons, a rare feature on e-readers. This allows you to turn the page without touching the screen with wet fingers. Since so few devices have page-turn buttons, we also chose e-readers that could be used with page-turn covers or remotes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tech is expensive these days, so we also considered value. If a device was over $200, it had to have special features that made us prioritize it over a more affordable device. We included devices at a variety of price points so no matter your budget, you can find a waterproof e-reader.

#571. A free way to make your earbuds sound better? Give them a deep clean.

📅 12 Nov 2026

A free way to make your earbuds sound better? Give them a deep clean.

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/tech/how-to-deep-clean-earbuds

I say this without judgment: you're likely overdue for an earbud clean.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, earwax, sweat from workouts, dirt, and dust — daily use exposes earbuds to a myriad of ways to get nice and dirty. And when was the last time you spot-cleaned them? Exactly.

Diungkapkan bahwa that's where the deep clean comes in. In other words, the less dirt getting into the internals of your buds, the better. In addition to the sanitation of it all, cleaning your earbuds periodically can help prevent damage that might impact their use, whether it be causing issues with the charging case, wear detection features, or even how the buds themselves sound. Even the best earbuds can start to suffer without proper maintenance. For optimal performance, Bose recommends cleaning your earbuds every two months.

Berdasarkan laporan, if the idea of cleaning your earbuds makes you worried you'll cause more harm than good, don't fret. It's easier than you think, and you likely have most, if not all, of the supplies already.

Micellar water (or distilled water, though regular water can also be used in a pinch).

Step 1: Remove the ear tips.

How to do this can vary slightly from model to model, but generally a light pinch and pull will get the job done.

Step 2: Wipe down the earbuds and exterior of the case with a dry microfiber cloth.

Step 3: Check specific earbuds guide for any areas you may need to avoid during cleaning.

For example, Apple's AirPods Pro instructions make clear where to avoid cleaning.

Sebagaimana diketahui, step 4: apply a very small amount of micellar water to a microfiber cloth, cotton swab, or soft bristled toothbrush. Lightly clean earbuds' mesh for 15 to 30 seconds.

You can repeat this step as many times as needed, but be sure to dry the mesh immediately after with a dry microfiber cloth.

Step 5: Use a microfiber cloth to wipe the interior of the case.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can use a small amount of micellar water here, but make sure your cloth is damp, not wet. If possible, avoid getting charging pins wet.

Step 6: Wipe ear tips down with microfiber cloth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in most cases, it's completely fine to also use a damp cloth here. However, if you're unsure, check specific instructions for brands. Sony recommends not getting the XM6 ear tips wet, while Bose and Apple say you can submerge the ear tips in water.

Step 7: Set aside ear tips to dry if necessary.

Diungkapkan bahwa tapping the ear tips on a towel to remove any excess moisture can work well here. You'll want to leave them sitting out in a secure, clean space while the rest of your earbuds dry.

Step 8: Dry case and earbuds for at least two hours.

This may seem like overkill (and honestly, in some cases, this probably is excessive), but letting the case dry open and the earbuds sit out on a clean surface guarantees that not a drop of moisture will threaten the performance of your earbuds.

Step 9: Replace the ear tips, and enjoy your newly cleaned buds!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, do: double-check the specific manufacturer instructions for your earbuds. Oftentimes, guides or specific cleaning instructions will tell you the specific areas to avoid on your earbuds. That might mean actually cracking open the user guide. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

Find cleaning instructions for Apple AirPods Pro models, Apple AirPods 4 and 5, Bose earbuds, Sony WF-1000XM6 earbuds, Beats Powerbeats Pro 2, Bowers & Wilkins Pi8 earbuds, and Soundcore earbuds.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, don't: put earbuds back into their charging case until both the earbuds and the case are completely dry. You didn't get your earbuds extra clean just to introduce moisture problems.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, do: be aware of small openings and ports. Minimizing moisture is key, so even when using a lightly damp cloth, it's important to avoid getting liquid into tiny openings, as it could affect the efficacy of the hardware. After using any damp materials for cleaning, dry your earbuds with another microfiber cloth immediately. Do NOT use any heat, such as hair dryers, as they're liable to cause damage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, don't: turn to harsh alcohols for disinfecting. While some brands — Beats and Soundcore included — mention using rubbing alcohol as a cleaning tool, several other brands warn against it. The harshness of the alcohol can degrade earbuds and ultimately affect performance, so relying on water, micellar water, or a dry cloth is ultimately the safest route.

Diungkapkan bahwa do: be careful with cotton swabs and charging cases. Though cotton swabs are a great shape for getting into nooks and crannies, their fibers can easily get caught and lodged into those same nooks and crannies. The best solution is to use a microfiber cloth instead — if you're having trouble maneuvering it, you can always wrap the cloth around the cotton swab to give yourself more dexterity.

#574. The 12 best phones of 2026, tested by experts

📅 12 Nov 2026

The 12 best phones of 2026, tested by experts

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/tech/best-smartphones-tested-2026

After extensive testing, we're ready to name the best smartphones of 2026, and we don't take these recommendations lightly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for most of us, our phone is the most important device we own. It's a lifeline to friends and family, and our primary gateway to the internet. And unless you're still carrying around a separate camera, your phone is also your means of documenting the world around you. There's a lot riding on this pocket-sized gadget!.

Diungkapkan bahwa mashable has been covering smartphones since 2011, and we've tested all of this year's most exciting releases so far, including the latest flagships and foldables from apple, samsung, and google. Phones have definitely gotten more expensive this year, but we have recommendations for every budget across both iOS and Android operating systems.

These are the tech, tools, and products — from laptops to e-readers, from earbuds to robovacs, and more — that Mashable ranks best in class.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you're in the market for a new phone right now, you should know that it'll cost you more than usual. New AI data centers are hogging supplies of memory and SSD storage chips, driving up their prices. (RAMageddon price hikes have also taken a toll on laptops and gaming consoles. The best phones were never cheap, but smartphone prices surged in 2026 amid a global RAM shortage driven by the AI boom (commonly known as "RAMageddon"). Consequently, consumer tech devices with memory components are also getting more expensive. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa so far, we've seen apple, google, and samsung all raise the prices of their new smartphones at launch. This fall, Samsung implemented another $100 to $200 price hike across its Galaxy S26 lineup, while Apple increased the prices of some older iPhones by $100. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with this in mind, it's especially wise to shop around for deals and carrier promotions before buying your new phone. Trading in an older device is the easiest way to save several hundred dollars on an upgrade. Some carriers will give you a new phone for free (in the form of monthly bill credits) if you also sign up for a new line or certain data plans. For example, the new iPhone 18 Pro is free with eligible trade-ins and plans through AT&T and T-Mobile.

Want to learn more about getting the best out of your tech? Sign up for Mashable's Top Stories and Deals newsletters or get Mashable push alerts today.

Berdasarkan laporan, the average ios user: most people will be perfectly happy with the regular iphone. Fast, long-lasting, pretty, and equipped with nice cameras, it's the Goldilocks of Apple handsets — not too basic, but not overkill.

Sebagaimana diketahui, impatient folks: the pro-level iphone just got an upgrade, but the iphone 18 probably isn't launching until march 2027. If you can't wait until then, last year's iPhone 17 is still a rock-solid buy.

Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone 17.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, apple didn't reinvent the wheel with this one — we might get a more dramatic redesign next year — but the iphone 17 is an awesome smartphone nonetheless. As he pointed out in his review, it's basically an iPhone 17 Pro with no telephoto lens, vapor chamber cooling system, or RAW video support. For a couple of hundred dollars less than a Pro model, you still get a buttery 120Hz display, stellar performance and battery life, and very capable main cameras with the iPhone 17. (That's the extent of their tangible differences that we noticed in testing, but I'll add that the regular iPhone also lacks a 1TB storage option. ) If you're not a specialty user in dire need of those features, it just makes sense to go with Apple's mid-range phone. In fact, "It's easily the most compelling standard iPhone in years," per Mashable senior editor Stan Schroeder. Its wider range of colors and less bulky, less polarizing design seals the deal.

Diungkapkan bahwa the average android user: if you're happily part of team android, then google makes some of the best phones in the mobile market. Google's latest flagship phone is largely the same device as its Pro-tier models (save for some even better cameras and an underwhelming LED notification system), but it comes in safely under $1,000. Out of all the Android phones we've tried, this one strikes the happiest medium between value and features.

Berdasarkan laporan, parents: the pixel 11 has a new magic capture camera feature that automatically takes and edits photos when you're recording video. Instead of trying to capture both at once or wrangle fast-moving kiddos for a picture, you can stay in the moment.

Read Mashable's full review of the Google Pixel 11.

The new Google Pixel 11 proves that you can get everything you need in an Android phone for under $1,000.

Berdasarkan laporan, google fine-tuned its flagship phone with a thinner design and a newer, faster chipset for 2026. (The two phones have the same processor, form factor, and battery life. Better cameras and a sharper display with an anti-scratch coating are the biggest things you get for splurging. Like Apple's regular iPhone, it's still a very slick smartphone even though it's not an exciting gen-over-gen upgrade. And also like Apple's regular iPhone, it has a lot in common with its pricier Pro-tier counterpart. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mashable tech reporter alex perry approved of the pixel 11's performance, writing: "apps load quickly and smoothly, on-device ai processing happens in a fairly snappy fashion, and the phone doesn't run all that hot, even without a case. " Perry also called out the Pixel 11's new AI-powered Magic Capture image capture feature and Rambler text-to-speech tool, which wowed him even as a self-proclaimed AI skeptic. Unavailable on older Pixel phones, they alone make a decent case for upgrading to the Pixel 11.

iOS users on a budget: The iPhone 17e is the cheapest, most accessible, most low-stakes entry point into the world of Apple phones.

Diungkapkan bahwa people who stash their phones in their pockets: the 6. It's not as light as the Air, but it's damn near close. 1-inch iPhone 17e is shorter than the iPhone 17 as well as the ultra-thin, ultralight iPhone Air. It's the most compact traditional (non-flip or foldable) phone on this list.

Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone 17e.

Berdasarkan laporan, this spring, apple refreshed its budget phone with magsafe charging, more starting storage, and a more powerful chip (the same one inside the regular iphone). The resulting iPhone 17e is a more convenient, future-proofed, and faster handset than before. It also takes slightly better photos in low-light settings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while the standard iphone 17 is a nicer device overall with vastly better cameras and a smoother display, the iphone 17e is still a good, reliable phone for penny-pinchers who like ios. It's a full $200 cheaper than its mid-tier counterpart, which is a significant difference for many shoppers.

Berdasarkan laporan, people who want to venture beyond apple, samsung, and google: nothing is a british tech company that also makes stylish and affordable headphones and smartwatches. This affordable handset proves that the best smartphones don't have to cost you $1,000 and up.

Design enthusiasts: The Phone (4a) Pro sports the funky, retro-inspired look that Nothing has come to be known for.

People with the strictest budgets: Starting at $499 with 128GB of storage, this is the least expensive phone we recommend — now even more so after the iPhone 17e's recent price bump.

Read Mashable's full review of the Nothing (4a) Pro.

Berdasarkan laporan, "if you want an under-$500 phone with flair," said mashable contributor adam doud, "it doesn't get more flair-ish than" the nothing phone (4a) pro. It has a striking retro-industrial look with a cool Glyph Matrix display on the back, which shows you the time, battery life, and other status indicators and notifications when it's face down. (Google just copied this feature, kind of. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, on the front, you'll find a surprisingly sharp amoled display with a top-tier 144hz refresh rate. Its mid-range processor isn't fast enough to handle games, but it's apt for everyday usage scenarios and easy on its battery: "I regularly got just under two days of light-medium use on a single charge. " Doud said. Google's identically priced Pixel 10a takes better pictures, but we think this is the better, snazzier budget Android phone overall.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mobile photographers who prefer ios: the iphone 18 pro takes fantastic photos in almost any environment, and it has much more customizable camera settings than lesser iphones — including a physical variable aperture. (The iPhone 18 Pro Max has the same shooters, but it's much less portable. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, folks who really like apple's new burgundy color: the iphone 18 pro and pro max are both available in the "dangerously chic" new hue, as mashable's shannon connellan put it. This model will appeal to more people because it's slightly cheaper and more pocket-friendly.

Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

Sebagaimana diketahui, apple's latest pro-tier handset has upgraded cameras with a new variable aperture on its main lens and new creator-friendly pro controls. All of these upgrades make the iPhone 18 Pro best-suited for serious shutterbugs who really like to fine-tune their camera settings, said Mashable senior editor Schroeder. There are new Photographic Styles, new Cinematic video effects, and a new Focus Tracking tool, to name a few. "That doesn’t mean the regular user won't benefit," he wrote, "but I do bet that the majority of people will try out the manual aperture setting once and then leave it on auto. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa plus, the iphone 18 pro is configurable with up to 2tb of storage — it has plenty of room for all of your shots. Apple rounded out its spec sheet with a long battery life and a turbocharged A20 chip that gives it ample processing power for Siri AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, heads up: early reviewers have reported some fading on the back of the burgundy and black iphone 18 pros, similar to the scratching problem with last year's cosmic orange iphone 17 pro. If that concerns you, either get a nice case or opt for the pretty new glacier blue iPhone 18 Pro instead. It doesn't seem to be having the same issue.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mobile photographers who prefer android: the pixel 11 pro takes the best photos of any android phone we've tested. (The standard Pixel 11 also has these features, though its cameras aren't quite as nice. Not only are its cameras spectacular, but it also supports some great software features that make sure its pictures turn out great every time — Magic Capture, for one. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, android users who want a high-end flagship with magnetic charging: unlike the samsung galaxy s26 series, including the s26 ultra, the pixel 11 has built-in magnets. You don't need to buy a separate case to make sure it's securely attached to wireless chargers or accessories. In other words, it supports magnetic charging by default. (The regular Pixel 11 also has magnets, FWIW. ).

Read Mashable's full review of the Google Pixel 11 Pro.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, admittedly, this category was a tight race between the pixel 11 pro and the samsung galaxy s26 ultra. (The Galaxy S26 Ultra's digital zoom maxes out at 100x. " Daytime shots, nighttime snaps, macro images, landscapes — in our experience, they all turn out great on the Pixel 11 Pro. So, why did we pick the former? Take it from Mashable's Alex Perry: "Photography is fun on the Pixel 11 Pro, which is not something I feel about many handsets these days," he wrote. "A combination of hardware and software makes your images consistently look nice, even in challenging lighting conditions. Also worth noting: Google upgraded its digital zoom to a whopping 120x. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cameras aside, we also gave high marks to this phone for its capable everyday performance, multi-day battery life, brighter display, and attractive color options. Its HiLight feature is kind of a flop, but the rest of it makes up for that.

Berdasarkan laporan, multitaskers on the move: the new iphone duo is thinner and lighter than apple's ipads, and it has a huge, gorgeous inner display with a glare-reducing "nano-texture" finish. Its design makes it great for on-the-go multitasking and entertainment (think reading, watching movies, or playing games); it can replace an e-reader or tablet in a pinch.

Diungkapkan bahwa stylus users: the duo is the only foldable we've tested that supports stylus input on its inner and outer displays. It works with the Apple Pencil (USB-C), which is sold separately for $79.

Diungkapkan bahwa early adopters: foldable phones aren't in their infancy anymore, but they're still pretty niche devices. And as Apple's very first foldable, the Duo has some quirks — namely, many apps aren't optimized for it yet. Its ideal buyer is a tech enthusiast who wants to check out the latest and greatest in smartphone design and is willing to put up with some bugs for a bit.

Diungkapkan bahwa people with cash to burn: the duo starts at an eye-watering $1,999, making it apple's most expensive phone ever — not to mention, the priciest phone on this list. (It maxes out at $3,199 with 2TB of storage. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, patient people: the duo was backordered for months at the time of writing. If you order it through the Apple Store right now, you probably won't get it until the opening weeks of 2027.

Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone Duo.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the iphone duo is the first and only foldable that apple's made so far, but it's quite impressive for a first-generation device. (We just wouldn't recommend turning it into an alarm clock as Apple suggests. ) It certainly helps that the Duo's matte inner screen is "the nicest phone display I’ve ever seen," said Senior Editor Stan Schroeder, who described it as "crisp, sharp, [and] beautiful to look at; it’s downright addictive. It's basically an iPhone that doubles as an iPad when unfolded — you can look at apps side by side, enjoy e-books and games in greater immersion, or use it as a MacBook's secondary display. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the duo has a passport-style design like the samsung galaxy z fold 8, our favorite android foldable, just with rounder corners for a more polished look. It runs on the same powerful A20 chip as the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, so it's zippy enough for all the multitasking your heart desires, and optimized apps work incredibly well. While the Duo doesn't last as long as those regular iPhones, its battery life is fine for a foldable.

Diungkapkan bahwa you'll have to temper your expectations with the duo's cameras — it lacks a telephoto lens, and the hidden facetime camera on its inner screen is straight-up "bad," schroeder said. That said, this is the case with most foldables.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on a final note, some inaugural duo owners reported that their device's inner screen cracked shortly after they started using it (a problem that's since become known as "crackgate"). The good news is that the issue doesn't seem to be as serious as social media might have you believe. In a statement, Apple told us that it's isolated to "a small number" of Duos, and that impacted buyers should contact AppleCare for a replacement.

Diungkapkan bahwa if it helps, schroeder has been using the duo for nearly a month and hasn't noticed any hinge or display defects with his review unit. What's more, another Duo has withstood more than 200,000 folds (and counting) inside the "Fold-a-Phone" machine built by our sister site, CNET; they're folding it 900 times an hour until it breaks. You can catch the livestream daily on CNET's YouTube channel.

Commuters and frequent travelers: Like Apple's iPhone Duo, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 has a compact and versatile passport-style design that's tailor-made for multitasking on the go.

Sebagaimana diketahui, reluctant guinea pigs: unlike apple, samsung has been making foldable phones for many years now. Our reviewer noticed some "very minor bugs" with certain apps on the Galaxy Z Fold 8, but "most of the time, the phone just works," he said. (We think the iPhone Duo's "crackgate" issue is largely overblown, but it's still something to be aware of. And its construction is pretty much rock solid at this point. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, people who like a lightweight foldable: this is the lightest folding phone we've tested. It's 21 percent lighter than the iPhone Duo, 16 percent lighter than the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold, and six percent lighter than Samsung's taller, book-style Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra.

Sebagaimana diketahui, folks who want an "affordable" foldable: the galaxy z fold 8 is $100 cheaper than apple's iphone duo. If we're really splitting hairs, it's technically the thriftier choice.

Read Mashable's full review of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8.

Diungkapkan bahwa google's pixel 11 pro fold is also a great android foldable, but ultimately, we prefer the wider, passport-style design of samsung's galaxy z fold 8 — it's sleeker and better for entertainment. (We also prefer it over the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra for similar reasons. Plus, its crease isn't as visible. ).

Diungkapkan bahwa the galaxy z fold 8's spacious inner amoled screen is "far and away" its biggest asset, said mashable's timothy beck werth. It's smooth and so bright. "I generally avoid streaming TV shows and movies on my phone, but not with the Z Fold 8," he wrote. "Likewise, while I've never been a huge fan of mobile gaming, the mobile version of Mario Kart looks and plays awesome here. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the display has a glare-free finish that makes it easy to view in direct sunlight, as well as samsung's new "flex titanium" tech that keeps its crease subtle and hinge strong. Other highlights of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 include peppy multitasking performance and all-day battery life. While its cameras aren't spectacular — most foldables' shooters aren't — they're sufficient for most non-pro users.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the most advanced iphone ever built is here, and it doesn't disappoint. So, who should buy the iPhone 18 Pro Max instead of the smaller iPhone 18 Pro?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, battery life maximizers: the iphone 18 pro max is rated for up to 45 hours of video playback. It's the longest-lasting phone we've ever tested.

Mobile gamers who prefer regular (non-foldable) phones: This handset features a blazing-fast processor and a huge vapor chamber thermal system, plus a smooth, crisp, and massive display.

Sebagaimana diketahui, people with big hands: at 8. 78 ounces, the iPhone 18 Pro Max is the heaviest regular phone we recommend. It's the same size as the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, but weighs 16 percent more.

Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.

Diungkapkan bahwa apple reorganized the components inside the iphone 18 pro max to squeeze in a giant new battery that can run for nearly two days between charges. It lasts up to nine hours longer than the smaller iPhone 18 Pro, no "Max. It's so big that the company had to add a special setting that keeps it within shipping limits on battery sizes. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the iphone 18 pro max's a20 pro chip ran laps around the competition in our benchmarking, and the new thermal management system that fills its chassis keeps it cool while you're running demanding apps. Mashable's Stan Schroeder "tested this out by playing a few games of PUBG: Battlegrounds on the highest settings for a full hour," and "The phone barely got warm," he wrote. Its battery life only fell by nine percent during that stress test, FWIW.

Diungkapkan bahwa the regular iphone 18 pro has the same hardware, but we think mobile gamers and movie-watchers will appreciate the bigger, more immersive screen on the "max" version. The two phones are basically identical otherwise, including their shooter setup. Opt for this model if you want the best iPhone for battery life and cameras.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "if there's ever been a phone to make you ditch apple, this is it," said mashable tech editor timothy beck werth. The question is, who should make the splurge?.

Berdasarkan laporan, advanced users: the samsung galaxy s26 ultra is a premium device with a zippy custom processor, a large, high-end display with stylus support, and elite cameras. It's "too much phone" for the average person, to quote our review; only professional creatives and developers will be able to use it to its full potential.

AI enthusiasts: This handheld comes crammed with powerful AI tools, including pre-loaded Gemini, Perplexity, and Bixby AI assistants.

Diungkapkan bahwa privacy sticklers: the galaxy s26 ultra has a unique built-in privacy display that blacks out your screen to those around you. It's not perfect, but it's still pretty sick — and you can't get it on any other phone, Android or otherwise.

Read Mashable's full review of the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in october, samsung raised the prices of the galaxy s26 phones it released back in march — and they were already more expensive than last year's s25 models. A new S26 Ultra will now cost you $1,400, while the 1TB version is a whopping $2,000. But if you want the finest, most future-proofed Android smartphone available, this is it.

Diungkapkan bahwa the galaxy s26 ultra is faster than some mid-range laptops we've tried, so it can run just about any app, mobile game, or fancy ai feature you need it to. Plus, its upgraded vapor chamber makes sure it never breaks a sweat. Its display would be elite even if its cutting-edge privacy screen feature weren't a thing — it's so crisp and bright. Its battery lasts all day, and its cameras are almost unrivaled: Photos taken on the Galaxy S26 are vibrant and detailed, even at night or zoomed in quite a bit.

Diungkapkan bahwa teens with deep-pocketed parents: the trendy little galaxy z flip 8 makes a great starter phone for a younger person (though it doesn't have a "starter" price). It's cute, durable, and easy to hold in one hand.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, people who don't obsess over photo quality: like foldables, flip phones aren't ideal for serious photographers. The Galaxy Z Flip 8's cameras underwhelm compared to those on regular phones that cost the same or slightly less.

Nostalgic Millennials: If you haven't used a flip phone since the early 2000s, this is a great entry point into the modern market.

Read Mashable's full review of the Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in addition to your usual next-gen upgrades — a faster processor, a slightly thinner, lighter design — the galaxy z flip 8 also features improved durability compared to last year's galaxy z flip 7. Like the Galaxy Z Fold 8, above, its new Flex Titanium display tech equates to a stronger hinge and a more subtle crease on its inner screen. Mashable tech editor Timothy Beck Werth was particularly enamored by its small size and "charming good looks," calling it "a smartphone with good vibes. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, its color options are few but cute; the pink one won over our newsroom full of apple users. While its cameras aren't much to write home about as a whole, it takes great selfies (as long as you don't use the selfie camera, ironically), and its AI image editing tools work really well. Regarding battery life, you should get over a day of use out of the Z Flip 8 before needing to charge it.

People who want a flip phone with great cameras: Flip phones aren't known for taking amazing pictures — Samsung's Galaxy Z Flip 8, above, is pretty representative of the market — but this model is an exception.

Folks who want a long-lasting flip phone: The latest Razr Ultra can last up to a day and a half away from an outlet, depending on your usage.

Fashionistas: This flip phone comes in two chic, Pantone-approved colorways featuring unique back covers.

Read Mashable's full review of the Motorola Razr Ultra.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if you can spend a little more on your flip phone, we really like the 2026 motorola razr ultra, which mashable tech editor timothy beck werth deemed "a conversation-starting beauty. " Both of its pretty AMOLED displays (inner and outer) are bigger, smoother, and brighter than the ones on last year's model.

Diungkapkan bahwa its external design is equally eye-catching: the pantone orient blue model's cover is finished in alcantara, a suede-like microfiber, while the pantone cocoa one has a wood veneer on the back. It takes "surprisingly good photos for a foldable," Werth said — better than the Galaxy Z Flip 8 for sure — capturing natural-looking colors and handling bright scenes well. Its 36-hour battery life is also an improvement over its Samsung counterpart, which taps out at 31 hours (same with the mid-tier Razr+, which also underwhelmed in the photography department).

Topics Android Apple Google iOS iPhone Samsung.

In early November 2026, I made some adjustments to this guide after our latest round of testing:.

The Apple iPhone Duo is our new favorite foldable iPhone.

The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 is now our top Android foldable.

Last month, I added the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max as picks for photography and battery life, respectively.

Berdasarkan laporan, released in fall 2025, the iphone air is apple's thinnest phone ever. We think it's a very pretty and well-made phone, but not one of the best overall. and costs $200 less). Its ultra-sleek design is appealing, but it has worse battery life and inferior cameras compared to the standard iPhone 17 (which runs on the same processor. For more info, check out our iPhone Air review and our dedicated guide to the best iPhones.

Berdasarkan laporan, mashable has been covering phones for over a decade and a half, since the launch of the iphone 4s, samsung galaxy s ii, and motorola droid razr in 2011. As of 2026, our team uses the following metrics to test and evaluate the best smartphones:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we spend several days to weeks with every phone we review. We stress test them by playing games on them, opening multiple apps at once, and trying any unique software features they support. We quantify their performance using Primate Labs' Geekbench CPU benchmark.

Berdasarkan laporan, throughout our testing periods, we measure how much a phone's battery drains with heavy usage. We also see how fast it charges. In more recent phone reviews, we've started conducted an additional video rundown test using "Tears of Steel," an open-source Blender movie.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we assess the overall design, construction, and ergonomics of each phone as we use it. Is it comfortable to hold? Can it fit in a pocket? How sharp is its display? Is it waterproof? What colors does it come in?.

Diungkapkan bahwa we test each of the phone's cameras in a variety of lighting conditions and settings. We take photos indoors and outdoors, in low and bright light; we get macro, zoom, and night shots, and we snap a bunch of selfies. We include the photos in our reviews for reference.

Mashable tech editor Timothy Beck Werth and tech reporter Alex Perry also contributed to this guide.

Berdasarkan laporan, haley henschel is a chicago-based senior shopping reporter at mashable who reviews and finds deals on popular tech, from laptops to gaming consoles and vpns. She has years of experience covering shopping holidays and can tell you what’s actually worth buying on Black Friday and Amazon Prime Day. Her work has also explored the driving forces behind digital trends within the shopping sphere, from dupes to 12-foot skeletons.

Firefox's New 'Mini Window' Feature Is a Game Changer for Productivity

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/firefoxs-new-mini-window-feature-is-a-game-changer?utm_medium=RSS

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, david nield is a technology journalist from manchester in the u. K. who has been writing about gadgets and apps for more than 20 years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he has a bachelor's degree in english literature from durham university, where he also spent a term as editor of the award-winning student newspaper palatinate. K. and internationally. His journalism career started in print media, where he contributed to and edited several technology magazines and bookazines sold in the U. More recently, he has worked as a freelancer for some of the biggest technology publications on the web, covering everything from on-the-ground reporting about product launches, to detailed explainers and how-to guides on apps, gadgets, and platforms. His expertise covers broad areas of consumer tech, including smartphones, laptops, wearables, and AI.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for many of us, web browsing involves juggling dozens of tabs at once, and it's easy for important pages to get lost in the chaos. Now, Firefox has introduced something I think could help us multi-taskers: a "Mini Window. " As highlighted by ZDNET's Jack Wallen, this new Firefox feature works like picture-in-picture overlays for videos—only here, that PiP displays a website.

Berdasarkan laporan, "[mini window] lets you move a tab, or a selected section of a page, into a compact window that stays on top of your other windows while you browse," runs mozilla's official blurb. "It's useful when you're multitasking and need to keep a few sources of information in view at once: Reference docs, a chat, a video call, a form you're filling out. " As such, Mini Window doesn't necessarily replace running tabs side-by-side; rather, you can prioritize one tab in a full-size window, while keeping another page in view at all times.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this is a feature that's still in its early stages, and right now you can only get it in the "nightly" version of firefox, a very early beta version of the browser. Mozilla says it will push the feature to the full version of the browser later this month.

Diungkapkan bahwa if you want to try this out as soon as possible, first install firefox nightly on your mac or pc. Once up and running, you can launch Mini Window by right-clicking on a tab header and choosing Move Tab > Move to Mini Window. The tab shrinks and drops down to the lower right corner by default, staying on top of all other windows (not just Firefox). You can then scroll through the page and follow links as normal in the Mini Window—any links set to open in a new tab (manually or automatically) will launch in the main Firefox view, not the window overlay.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by dragging the title bar around, you can put your mini window anywhere you want on screen, and you can change its size by dragging the edges of the window too—so it doesn't necessarily have to be all that "mini. " Firefox hides all buttons by default—including forward, backward, and refresh buttons, together with the address bar and buttons for closing the window or putting it back as a normal tab—though they appear when you hover over the Mini Window.

Berdasarkan laporan, i'm finding the feature most useful when writing up articles where i need to refer to something else already on the web (so almost all of them), but there are a host of ways this can be used. It's particularly handy on a small laptop, where you don't necessarily have the screen space to put two tabs side by side, or when running a lower-priority window (like checking a social media site while reading an important document). No doubt, Firefox will continue to refine and improve the feature as it makes its way to the stable version of the browser, and it feels like something other browsers (looking at you, Google Chrome) might adopt as well in the near future. Eventually, using Mini Windows might become as common as opening up a long row of tabs.
