#579. Voyager 1 is about to hit one light-day away. NASAs planning to party.

📅 12 Nov 2026

Voyager 1 is about to hit one light-day away. NASAs planning to party.

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/science/nasa-voyager-1-light-day-activities

If you step outside tonight and flick a flashlight toward deep space, that split-second pulse will race through the void at 186,000 miles per second.

Berdasarkan laporan, the light will continue its journey while you sleep, while you eat, while you go to work. Only when you reach the same time tomorrow could its photons potentially wash over a spacecraft more than 16 billion miles away.

Berdasarkan laporan, that robotic probe is nasa's voyager 1, the farthest human-made object in the universe. m. One light-day is the distance light travels over 24 hours. 18. It will cross the one light-day-away milestone at 5:16 a. ET on Wednesday, Nov. Radio signals move at the speed of light, so any message from Earth would need a full day to reach the spacecraft. Considering Voyager 1 never stops moving, that communication lag will only increase.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to mark the occasion, the u. space agency has a couple of things planned, one of which involves pointing that flashlight toward the sky. S. The day after the milestone, you can watch the mission team talk about where the spacecraft has been and how it keeps going.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, voyager 1 left earth in 1977 to explore the giant outer planets. The probe finished its tour decades ago but kept going at nearly 38,000 mph. NASA timed the launch to catch a lineup of those planets that comes around only once every 176 years. In 2012, it left the heliosphere, the protective bubble the sun blows around our solar system, and entered interstellar space.

Sebagaimana diketahui, its twin, voyager 2, took a different path past uranus and neptune and left the solar system in 2018. But Voyager 2 won't reach a light-day until November 2035, most likely after it has depleted its fuel.

Diungkapkan bahwa that's the bittersweet reality of voyager 1's historic achievement: both probes are dying, nearly tapped out of their nuclear power sources that turn heat from decaying plutonium into electricity. Since 2024, the team has shut off two science instruments on each spacecraft to stretch what's left. Sooner or later, the power will run out, and no one will be able to talk with the twins at all, regardless of time delays.

Diungkapkan bahwa for now, though, the mission team is only thinking happy thoughts. The first way to get involved comes after sunset on Tuesday, Nov. NASA is asking people around the world to point a light at the sky to spell out VGR, Voyager's call sign, in Morse code. 17. Morse code is an old telegraph language that turns each letter into a pattern of short and long signals.

Diungkapkan bahwa the easiest way to do this is with a phone or tablet. After sunset, open the flasher in your device's web browser, point the device's screen at the sky, and let it send the signal. NASA built an online flasher that blinks the code for you. (You can bookmark this story to keep the flasher link handy. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, if you'd rather tap it out yourself, grab a flashlight, and switch it on and off or use your hand to block and unblock the beam. Short flashes, called dots, should last less than a second. Long flashes, called dashes, should last about one second.

You can repeat the pattern as many times as you like.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, even if you were to point your flashlight in precisely the direction of voyager 1, the beam would fan out into a cone billions of miles wide, scattering its photons across the void. Because the light is diluted in space, virtually every photon would sail past the tiny 12-foot spacecraft without ever hitting it.

Diungkapkan bahwa but it's a symbolic gesture for wishing the old mission godspeed. You can tag @NASA on your photos and videos if you post them to X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, or other social media.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the second way to join in the celebration comes at noon et / 9 a. Mission leaders and top NASA science officials will meet at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California to talk about the twins. 19. They'll explain how the spacecraft are holding up, what they're still learning beyond the sun's bubble, and how engineers keep such old hardware running from far away. m. PT on Thursday, Nov. The public can watch on NASA's streaming service, NASA+, or Youtube.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the team has plenty to talk about. " They turned off three power-hungry devices on each probe that help keep it warm, and at the same time they switched on three lower-power replacements. This year, engineers tried a fix they nicknamed the "Big Bang. The swap should keep them running for at least another year.

Diungkapkan bahwa but at this stage, the team has come to expect the unexpected. Last month, Voyager 1 had a mysterious issue with its thrusters that briefly caused a communication blackout. Engineers are still trying to figure out what caused the problem.

Diungkapkan bahwa if the distant spacecraft could send you a morse code message back, perhaps it would say the one recorded on its golden record: "ad astera per aspera. " In Latin, that means "to the stars through struggles. ".

#582. Rings of Power star Tyroe Muhafidin talks Theos dark side, Witch-king theories, and that heartbreaking death

📅 12 Nov 2026

Rings of Power star Tyroe Muhafidin talks Theos dark side, Witch-king theories, and that heartbreaking death

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/entertainment/tyroe-muhafidin-interview-the-lord-of-the-rings-the-rings-of-power-theo

Tyroe Muhafidin is ready to embrace his villainous side.

Berdasarkan laporan, the 20-year-old actor plays theo in the lord of the rings: the rings of power, his first professional role. A young Southlander, Theo has spent the first two seasons of the series caught up in a battle between good and evil that he can barely understand. But in Season 3, Theo hopes to take matters into his own hands, a choice that brings him face to face with Sauron (Charlie Vickers).

Sebagaimana diketahui, over the course of season 3's first four episodes, theo officially joins sauron's army as a nazgnagôl, or ring-servant. Later, in one of the show's heaviest scenes, he kills his former mentor, the elf Arondir (Ismael Cruz Córdova), at Sauron's command. Between accepting a ring of power and murdering Arondir, Theo's arc has bent entirely toward darkness, especially since the Nazgnagôl will soon become entirely corrupted, turning them into the Nazgûl of The Lord of the Rings.

In a conversation with Mashable, Muhafidin unpacked Theo's turn to the dark side, his final scene with Córdova, and whether Theo may become the Witch-king of Angmar, as the show so heavily implies.

Berdasarkan laporan, this season, theo gets up close and personal with sauron. In the first episode, he and the men of Pelargir head to Mordor for a ring of power. Tell me about how the five years under Númenórean rule have led to this decision from Theo.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the last five years, i think any of those dwindles of hope that theo had have now all dissipated. Basically, in the first two seasons, Theo was was very hopeful for a better life, and he really did believe that something good was going to come for his people. Then it just became pain upon pain upon pain, and loss upon loss for him. Five years, especially for a human, is enough time to set in stone for him the idea that those good days weren't ever coming, and if he was ever going to have any life that's different to the one that he's having now, it would be in Barad-dûr.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that fight between the southlanders for the ring is the most involved combat theo's been in so far. Walk me through training for that scene and embodying that fight-or-die feeling.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i feel like i've never really done anything where i was the attacker. A lot of the stunty stuff that Theo had done prior was always him running away from something. So I feel like this is the first time, and it's showing that he's grown now, and he can take on battles for himself, full-on, headfirst.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that fight was a bit hectic. He's on top of me, and you think that he would be heavy, but he did such a great job at keeping his weight just enough off me that it looked like I was holding all this weight. Adam [Basil], who's the loveliest guy ever — he's this 6-foot-8 guy, and his name on the call sheet was "Big Farmer" — was absolutely a dream to work with. It was really fun, but it was really grueling to shoot. The conditions in Barad-dûr aren't the most fun. There's fire everywhere and blood everywhere, and it's dark. It took us a few weeks to choreograph and nail down. But I guess that's the exact vibe that Sauron's lair would have!.

Speaking of Sauron, I'd love to hear more about working with Charlie Vickers this season and establishing that intriguing dynamic between Theo and Sauron.

Berdasarkan laporan, working with charlie was a dream. We were all out in New Zealand by ourselves, and he'd invite me around to play FIFA with him a bunch. It was kind of like an uncle relationship, Uncle Charlie. He'd always had a particular kind of arm around me since the first season. So we already had this dynamic, and now actually working with him, we could actually build upon that kind of big bro energy.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's been certain moments that they've shared prior, like the moment where theo held the sword up and said, "strength to the southlands. " Halbrand, at the time, recognized that. So, I think Sauron had an eye out for Theo. I think the moment that he stepped into Barad-dûr, her knew there was something about this kid.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i love the whole scene where sauron uses dark magic to invite theo to commune with his late father. What's running through Theo's mind in that moment as he learns the truth about his father and his ties to Mordor?.

Diungkapkan bahwa at this point, his mind is racing. He just did a complete fight to the death with six other guys, and now he's having to talk to the Dark Lord and meeting his dad all of a sudden, whom he hasn't known for the last 20 years. It's literally the most insane sequence of events, so at this point he's genuinely the most vulnerable, mentally. It's so filled with everything, it would be hard for him to think rationally at all. His brain is at a point now where it will soak up anything that Sauron says to him, and it has left him easy to manipulate.

Berdasarkan laporan, finding out who his dad was is a question that he's asked his entire life, and when he learns, it's disbelief and shock. It's one of those things where you've been wondering for so long, so when you find out, you can't believe that it's true anyway. It's this weird, in-between world of knowing now, but still feeling like he doesn't know. I think Sauron can use that uncertainty in his brain, and with the presence of a ring, it was very easy to say what needed to be said.

Berdasarkan laporan, i have to talk about the witch-king in the room, because sauron tells theo he has it in him to be a sorcerer and a king. Obviously, a very famous sorcerer king with a ring of power in The Lord of the Rings is the Witch-king of Angmar. Are you able to confirm that Theo is going down that path?.

Berdasarkan laporan, [laughs] you could theorize along those lines, maybe, but i guess you'd have to ask [co-creators] j. D. [Payne] and Patrick [McKay] about that one.

Berdasarkan laporan, theo puts on the ring and becomes one of the ring-servants. When did you learn that this darkness was really going to become a part of his arc?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there was always a presence of it from the first season. With the sword hilt, there was already a connection to the dark side, and there was the scene with Waldreg [Geoff Morrell] at the watchtower trying to get him to join him. There've been temptations throughout, and they were planted carefully, so that when it came to the point that he got offered the ultimate question, he'd already been broken down gradually, and let the darkness in so much that it was easy to say yes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'd only found out just just before season 3 i actually get a ring. In the five years prior to that, I'd been poking at J. D. and Patrick saying, "Will I get a ring? Will I get a ring?".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, they always flipped it back on me, asking, "should theo get a ring?" and i was like, "i don't know. That's too much pressure!".

Diungkapkan bahwa i did a little bit of sweet talking all the way through, saying it'd be cool to play a villain. Villain arcs are really cool, and there's some cool depth to them. Theo does have a real great sense of depth and reasoning behind his darkness.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, speaking of the rings, they all look different. Did you get a choice in which one you got to put on?.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think i got the coolest. I remember seeing them all and being like, "I hope that one's mine. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, then when i got my costume for the first time, i got to see which ring was mine, and it was exactly the one i wanted. It was my favorite one out of all of them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we have to talk about the costume, because the image of the nazgnagôl armor and mask recalls the nazgûl in lord of the rings, and that has a lot of weight for the series. What was it like, stepping into that for the first time?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'd done a lot of movement workshops and things like that to try and gauge a sense of the power that the nazgnagôl would have. I'd done it for a few weeks before any kind of costume fitting, but it wasn't until the day that I had my first costume fitting — there was no armor or crown or anything, it was literally just a bunch of black robes — that I immediately could feel the darkness attached to it. You could get a sense of power, even just in the robes. Then at each costume fitting, they introduced more and more to the costume, and then by the last costume fitting, I'd fully felt the power.

Berdasarkan laporan, i also requested if i could do some movement workshops in the costume, because it was actually really complicated to move in. The crown is essentially an extension of your head, so any movement of your head will be really exaggerated at the end of the crown. We had to figure out how to walk in a way so our heads weren't bobbing a bunch. There was a sense of trying to move like you're floating, because if we didn't do that, the crown would have just made us look goofy.

What's the secret to moving like the Nazgnagôl?.

Berdasarkan laporan, there's a sense of real strength and power, but also a sense of otherworldliness. I think once the costume's on, though, it does 80 percent of the work for you. It was very much about moving with a slight bend at the knees, so every time you're moving, it's more of a glide than a walk. The Nazgnagôl live in both the mortal life and the immortal life, so we wanted them to move as if they were in between worlds, and they're coming from one world to another. You just automatically feel it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's very imposing. We've got to talk about the final scene of episode 4, with Arondir's death. Tell me about filming that final scene with Ismael and finding that last connection?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we shot that scene over two weeks, so we'd shot that specific sequence and the stabbing multiple times without getting any close up. It was daunting, but it was very fun. We had a really great time, and it was a really great group of us on set. It was a big celebration of Ismael and all the hard work that he's put into this job and how awesome Arondir is. It was fun though. We were having fun on set, and then the day came where we were doing our close-ups, and the air just felt cold, and everyone could feel the sad energy. We'd done it wide a bunch of times, and every point up until then, we were really light-hearted. We got a lot closer, because we could open up on our feelings. Feeling so deeply at that time in that moment, it really opened up a big space for us to connect. It was so heavily emotional, like for both of us, it was a real bonding and brotherhood moment. I'm so glad that he got to do all this really cool shit at the end.

What was your reaction to first reading that Theo stabs him?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i knew beforehand. I was like, "Oh, I guess that was the whole secret they were trying to keep from me. and Patrick's plan was to wait for me to just get the script and read it, but Charlotte Brandstrom, the first episode director, just blurted it out to me. D. I think initially J. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa so, i knew it was coming, but i didn't know how. Reading it, I just didn't imagine it to be as heartfelt as it was. I always thought that it was going to be a lot colder and a lot quicker. I knew at some point if I was going to go to the dark side, there would be a confrontation between them, because obviously they're fighting on opposing ends of the war, and they're both frontmen. So, reading it and seeing how close he was to really accepting Arondir was really heartbreaking. This is actually such a love-filled scene, and that's why it's so tragic and so heartbreaking, because there is so much love between them, and it just disappears in an instant, which leaves a real hollow feeling at the end of the episode.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there's that moment of compulsion from sauron that makes theo stab arondir. What's he thinking at that moment? Is he reevaluating his choice, or is his humanity too far gone?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, theo is definitely someone who's been a product of who his role models are and who is giving him guidance. But then when he sees Arondir's face, all those ideas that Sauron had planted disappear, and he's almost ready to accept the hand that's put out in front of him because he can see the the love in Arondir's eyes. This is the moment where his two biggest role models in his life at this point are meeting head to head. That moment when Sauron arrives is him thinking, "Oh yeah, I remember what I'm supposed to be doing now. For the last few weeks, Theo has been under the influence of Sauron. He has been fed however many ideas in his head about the elves. " It flips back into work mode, or servant mode.

Berdasarkan laporan, right now we know the nazgnagôl as ring-servants, but we know that the final iteration of them is the nazgûl, who are totally far gone. Assuming Theo stays on this path, what is an element of that transformation that you're most excited to play?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the cool thing about the nazgnagôl and the nazgûl is that they have a completely different living experience to anything else in middle-earth. They are living in between two worlds, and so you're trying to explore what it looks like to be detaching from the mortal world, becoming more spirit-like, and losing a sense of reality while being completely controlled and manipulated. It'll be really interesting because at this point in time, the Nazgnagôl are still men. They have autonomy over themselves and their decisions and what they can do, whereas it'd be great to see them slowly not be able to do that.

Diungkapkan bahwa the show has such a massive array of locations to visit. Going forward, what is one of the worlds within Middle-earth that you would like to work in?.

Berdasarkan laporan, i would love, love, love to do work in númenor. Everything around it is so glorious and beautiful, and there's a real community vibe. Any time I've been on the sets with the Númenóreans, they all seem to be getting along real well, whereas I've been hanging out with orcs who most of the time aren't that happy. The sets are just so magnificent. [laughs].

And who is someone from the ensemble you'd love to work with?.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'd love to do work with more or at least more stuff with leon [wadham], who plays kemen. When we were shooting Season 3, he was actually living above me, so we were constantly just borrowing stuff off each other all the time and just talking about work or whatever. I love Leon. We only ever had two days on set, and it was the last scene of Season 2 and the first scene of Season 3. I really wish we had more to do. But I also just think Kemen is not a nice guy.

Berdasarkan laporan, every time he's on screen, i'm angry. I don't even care if Theo's on the dark side. He deserves his vengeance a little.

Yeah, I'd love for Theo to face off against Kemen and give him what he deserves.

10 Shows Like 'Phony' You Should Watch Next

Sebagaimana diketahui, ross johnson writes about television, film, and literature for lifehacker. He has a degree in political science from the University of Rochester and has previously been a legal writer and editor for Thomson Reuters, for which he later traveled around India and the Middle East as an educator specializing in American English style and grammar for adults.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ross has been an actor on stage, in commercials, and in independent films since childhood, and has written hundreds of articles and essays on genre literature and cinema for barnes & noble, gizmodo, kotaku, and yahoo! entertainment. You can find him on Bluesky.

This is Streamalikes, where you can find a curated list of recommendations to stream based on what you already like.

Diungkapkan bahwa what if you knew your mom wasn't really your mom, but no one believed you? that's the improbable but entertaining premise of hulu's phony, which stars sam nivola as a teenager who wakes up from a car accident and quickly comes to believe that his mother (friday night lights' connie britton) is an imposter. Of course, no one believes him. I'm not sure I believe him, but it'll be pretty boring if it turns out that he just had a really bad concussion the whole time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's a coming-of-age drama and a surreal mystery with hints of comedy, and though it borrows elements from other shows, it stands apart for the skill with which it blends everything together. While you wait to see how the story plays out, here are 10 more twisted mysteries to stream now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a twisty-turny (and well-reviewed) bit of fake identity folderol, apple cider vinegar stars kaitlyn dever as belle gibson, a real-life australian cancer survivor (except not really!) with a cheeky sense of humor and a willingness to distort reality, the show follows the wellness influencer as she fakes multiple cancer diagnoses in order to better market her alternative, maha-esque app and remedies to the unwitting. As her livelihood comes under threat, her lies grow more elaborate. Stream Apple Cider Vinegar on Netflix.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, alia shawkat stars here as dory sief, an aimless millennial who decides, after seeing a missing-person poster for a college acquaintance, that she's going to make it her purpose to track her down—with the extremely begrudging support of her friends. Initially a darkly comic take on a Nancy Drew-style mystery, it later finds the gang desperate to cover up a mostly unintentional murder, and getting in deeper each season. But neither Chantal nor her disappearance are anything like what Dory expects. It's a funny, smart, and weird and shares talent with Phony in the form of writer/producer Anthony King, who serves as co-showrunner on the new series. The show shifts focus from season to season. Stream Search Party on Netflix.

Berdasarkan laporan, this one's largely about adults, so it skips the coming-of-age angle central to phony, but it has a quirky mystery, gaslighting, and a protagonist whose sanity is questioned by just about everyone all the same. This fun and very loose adaptation of the 1989 Tom Hanks film finds Keke Palmer's Samira and Jack Whitehall's Rob moving back to his impossibly safe and tidy hometown. As Samira adjusts to new motherhood and life on the cul-de-sac, she learns that even the nicest of her neighbors have secrets, and comes to suspect that her husband knows more about the missing girl than he's letting on. Their house happens to be across the street from a dilapidated Victorian eyesore that may or may not have been the location of a murder a couple of decades before—a murder of a girl who made the mistake of trying to get away. Stream The 'Burbs on Peacock.

Diungkapkan bahwa when pretty, popular girl kate wallis (olivia holt) goes missing without a trace in 1993, awkward jeanette turner (chiara aurelia) steps in to fill the gap, modeling herself after kate, working her way into the missing girl's social circle, and getting close with her boyfriend. There's even more going on, as the show shifts back and forth between 1993, 1994, and 1995 to slowly reveal the missing pieces. Whoops. That's all going great until Kate reappears two years later, accusing Jeanette of having witnessed the events around her disappearance and keeping quiet. Stream Cruel Summer on Hulu.

Diungkapkan bahwa based on a harlan coben novel, fool me once is a bit more of a political thriller than a coming-of-age thing, but we're still in "what the hell is up with my family?" territory: michelle keegan plays maya stern, a former special ops pilot dealing with the murder of her husband, whom she then impossibly catches playing with their daughter on a nanny cam. The resulting mystery ties into the earlier death of her sister and leads to a web of conspiracy involving her husband's family and a shady pharmaceutical company. Stream Fool Me Once on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a vibe match more than anything else, this dark and twisty mystery with a slightly surreal sense of humor also features a single mom who is definitely not what she appears to be. The show shifts perspectives continually, feeling most like Phony when it focuses on Mo-mi's daughter. On top of her boring office job, she puts on a blonde wig and a mask to perform as a camgirl for anonymous men. It's a means to express herself creatively and sexually with a level of control—until a mistake causes her to lose that control, a co-worker discovers her secret life, and desperation leads to murder. So, in order to fill that void, she's got a side hustle. Kim Mo-mi (Lee Han-byeol, initially), the Mask Girl of the title, is a uniquely complicated woman; she always wanted to be a K-Pop idol, but it was always made clear to her that she's not nearly pretty enough for that kind of stardom. Stream Mask Girl on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, flipping things around a bit, albeit in a similar "am i just being paranoid?" vein, the girlfriend deals with a mom who may or may not be freaking out for no reason. But is there more to it? Can someone with the name "Cherry Laine" truly be trusted? There's definitely something off, and we're kept guessing as to whether or not this is the story of a dangerous con artist or an overbearing mom—or maybe a little of each. Starring Robin Wright as Laura Sanderson, a wealthy art gallery owner in London whose son (Laurie Davidson) brings home a new, working-class girlfriend, Cherry Laine (Olivia Cooke)—immediately strikes Laura as not-our-kind. Stream The Girlfriend on Prime Video.

Sebagaimana diketahui, coming from irish playwright and derry girls creator lisa mcgee, this show eschews the relatively subtle dark comedy of phony for something much more gloriously surreal. The tone is all over the place in a way that somehow works, with flashes of sincerity balancing out the comedy. Three high school friends from Belfast reunite after learning that an estranged bestie has died unexpectedly—except that maybe she didn't; a mixed blessing given that they all have secrets that they were hoping would be buried with the maybe departed. Now they're off to investigate the mystery of the murder(?), which turns into a hunt for the friend that they only thought they knew, while inadvertently revealing plenty of secrets of their own. Stream How to Get to Heaven From Belfast on Netflix.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shin hye-sun offers up a phenomenal performance as sarah kim (well: sort of), a wealthy businesswoman who is discovered, at the series' opening, under a sewer grate. Though it takes itself more seriously than Phony, it's still an addictively twisty mystery built around a constructed identity. The police detective charged to investigate quickly finds inconsistencies in the woman's identity, and after interviewing Sarah's friend and business associate, comes to feel that neither woman is exactly (or anything, like she seems. Stream The Art of Sarah on Netflix.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's a lot going on in this steamy, telenovela-esque drama. If anything, she's the sketchy one: a dancer, not a nurse as she said, and with a possessive ex following her around. Camila Román (Carolina Miranda) finally meets Fernando Castell (Rodolfo Salas), a Tinder match, in Las Vegas, and things get very hot very quickly—he's everything he seemed to be and then some. Still, it's all going great until she decides to surprise Fernando after he flies back to Colombia (which: never do that), and gets a totally different dude when she asks for him at his work. And that's just the beginning! Stream Fake Profile on Netflix.

What is it about? Watch "The Jigsaw Puzzle Murder" on Paramount+ now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, thursday is a big day for zelda fans. , non-open-world) 3D Zelda game since the 2016 Twilight Princess remake on Wii U. That's when the remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time officially launches on Switch 2, marking the first major linear (i. I, for one, have been waiting for this day for years. e. I loved the N64 original and the 3DS remake, so to have the chance to play a modern take on the definitive Zelda is so exciting—that is, if it actually runs as it should.

Berdasarkan laporan, i stumbled upon this interesting post on x from austin john plays, a youtuber with a host of zelda coverage. According to Austin John Plays, Ocarina of Time already ships with a weird glitch that won't necessarily break your experience, but which may slow it down for a while, and perhaps even confuse players into thinking something is wrong with their game or their console.

As his post explains, if you're playing the physical copy of Ocarina of Time, and it's the first game you've ever played on your Switch 2—maybe you got one of those fancy new Zelda anniversary consoles and want to break it in properly?—you may run into glaring performance issues: The game may freeze, your controller may stop working, and the FPS may drop to single digits.

Berdasarkan laporan, luckily, austin john plays says the fix is easy: just wait. Instead, close the game, restart your Switch 2, then try relaunching Ocarina of Time. When it does, don't try to play right away. Austin John Plays advises you may need to repeat this process two or three times, but after that, you shouldn't continue to run into issues. Eventually, your game will boot back to the title screen. I wouldn't be surprised if Nintendo releases a patch right away for this glitch if it turns out to be as widespread as this post implies.

Diungkapkan bahwa however, seeing as the game doesn't come out until tomorrow, there's something you can do to prevent it. As such, download a game from the e-shop—even a free demo—just to get the system running. Austin John Plays thinks the bug only impacts Switch 2 consoles that haven't run other games before. If you've had your console a while, you're likely set. But if you just bought the 40th anniversary Zelda edition of the Switch 2, you might not have had a chance to run a game on it yet. Hopefully, that will be enough to circumvent the glitch, and prevent issues when Ocarina of Time launches tomorrow.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple's iphone duo has been my main phone for a month. I switched from the iPhone 17 Pro Max (I only tested the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max for a week), set up all my apps (including online banking and other finance apps, which typically require a more complicated setup) on the Duo, and put my other phones in a drawer.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is a different type of test than a typical phone review. Once you've switched to a new phone entirely, you're looking for apps that don't work and annoyances that can't be fixed. When you're writing a review, you're looking for the new and exciting. Had I found enough of these, I would've gone back to the Pro.

Diungkapkan bahwa but i feel zero desire to do so. The iPhone Duo has plenty of quirks, but none that would make me go back. The iPhone Duo is a game-changer for me. In fact, I dread the moment when I'll have to go back to a regular-sized phone to do a review. I am now a foldable phone guy.

Berdasarkan laporan, for my detailed review of the iphone duo, go here. In this article, I'll skip the details and highlight the interesting bits.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my iphone duo works just as well as it did on the first day. I know that some unlucky folks have had screen trouble, but I haven't had anything of the sort so far. The dreaded crease is still barely visible. The hinge works smoothly. In fact, the only real trouble I've had with the Duo has been grease buildup on the inner display, which appears near-impossible to remove (but is, fortunately, invisible most of the time).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, not only did the hardware hold up, but i've gotten completely used to it. It's become second nature, and I don't think about it anymore. I perform the little tasks (check out a message, see the weather forecast) on the front display; I flip the phone open for anything taking longer than five seconds. I still awkwardly search for the volume buttons sometimes, but even that doesn't bother me much; I know they're there, somewhere.

Diungkapkan bahwa the camera is the duo's weak point, and i do miss the telephoto option. The Duo's camera isn't bad, but it's roughly in line with what you'd get on an iPhone 16 or 17, and that can be hard if you've used a recent Pro model. If there's one thing that would make me go back to a non-Duo phone, it would be the camera. For now, I'm sticking with it, but I really hope the next Duo gets a lot of improvements in this area.

Sebagaimana diketahui, battery life isn't a problem. The best tech deal this week The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile Products available for purchase through affiliate links. It's not as good as battery life on the iPhone 18 Pro Max, but it the Duo lasts a full day for me. Still, I've never had to charge it more than once per day, which is good enough for me. It really depends on how you use it, and the Duo beckons you to use it more for gaming and videos, which drains the battery faster. The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile.

Berdasarkan laporan, by far the most annoying bugs have to do with the fact that the iphone duo has four cameras and many apps still don't know when to invoke which one. Making a video call on Messenger, WhatsApp, or Apple's own FaceTime will yield different results depending on how the phone is turned; sometimes you'll be upside down for no good reason. Sometimes, the person you're on a call with will be in a narrow, vertical window awkwardly positioned in the middle of that large, horizontal inner display. I have no doubt this will all get fixed over time, but it is taking a bit too long.

Diungkapkan bahwa the other annoyance is that some apps still haven't been properly updated for the duo, and that could take months or perhaps years to fix. Others have been tweaked to fit the big display better, but those tweaks were just quick fixes. This includes some apps I use daily, such as Google Authenticator and TradingView. This isn't hard to get used to, but it just feels like the overall app experience on the Duo could and should be so much better.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the other day, i watched two entire episodes of slow horses on the iphone duo. I've never done something like that on any phone; the displays were always too small. Given the Duo's screen size, brightness, and quality, watching on the Duo would actually be an improvement over a crappy hotel TV (and TVs in hotels are still very often very crappy).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on my desk, i now have the iphone duo all the time as an additional display. I use it to control music, check my calendar and reminders, and manage my smart home devices. In fact, wherever I go, I prop the Duo up beside me; it's like a more portable HomeView.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, showing a bunch of photos to someone, playing a video for a group, and browsing through a shopping site together with my wife are all tasks that are borderline annoying on a regular phone, and almost invariably end with someone giving up very quickly. On the Duo, the experience is great, and is invariably greeted with the same comment: "That screen is nice. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, oh, and the fact that the stereo speakers are pretty great also helps a lot when you're playing music on the duo. Theoretically, you can prop up any phone on a table and play music, but you'll rarely do it because the sound is thin and tinny. On the Duo, it's good enough to be the background entertainer at a small gathering.

Berdasarkan laporan, keeping it simple: how many times do i hold the duo in my hand and think, "damn, i wish i had a different phone now"? the answer is never. Or, perhaps, only when I need to take a photo, and even then the Duo is better for actually viewing the photos I've taken.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the advantages of having an iphone with a massive, beautiful, ipad mini-like display in your pocket simply outweigh all of the compromises that you have to make with the duo. And I don't see myself going back anytime soon.

#589. Your Android Can Get Hacked Without You Doing Anything at All

📅 04 Nov 2026

Your Android Can Get Hacked Without You Doing Anything at All

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/tech/your-android-can-get-hacked-without-you-doing-anything-at-all?utm_medium=RSS

Diungkapkan bahwa you probably know that clicking suspicious links online or opening attachments from strangers in an email or text is a recipe for hacking. However, the danger doesn't always involve something you do. It's a dangerous world out there online, so it's always important to be vigilant. There are ways to hack your devices without requiring any intervention on your part whatsoever—and one such example is likely plaguing your Android device right now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as reported by the hacker news, there is a critical android security flaw that could enable remote code execution on your device. In other words, bad actors could use the flaw to run their own code on your phone, effectively taking over the device for their own gain. The flaw, identified as CVE-2026-58868, isn't universal, but it is widespread: It currently affects Android 14 through Android 17, the latest version of Google's OS. If your phone runs Android 12 or Android 13, it may be unaffected, as Google doesn't identify these versions in its security bulletin, but it doesn't explicitly rule them out, either.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are two silver linings here, however. While that isn't a guarantee that bad actors have missed this exploit so far, it at least opens that possibility. One, Google hasn't confirmed any active exploits for this security flaw. The patch may not be available to you right away, however, as it's up to both the manufacturer of your phone and your carrier to issue these updates. As such, there may be time for users to patch their devices before hackers truly take advantage of the flaw. Second, Google does have a patch for the flaw. Still, a patch is, at the very least, on its way.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this flaw is perhaps the most important to fix, but it's not the only serious issue. In all, Google's latest bulletin highlights 216 vulnerabilities, and, of those, 23 are "critical. " As The Hacker News explains, two other of those critical flaws could also allow remote code execution when exploited.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to see whether the patch is installed on your end, open the settings app on your phone, tap "about phone" or "about tablet," then choose the android version on-screen. Look for a date of "2026-11-01" or later. All security patches from Nov. 1 and on will fix this issue. If not, you'll ned to wait for the patch.

#594. Eight 'Winter Arc' Rules That Will Actually Deliver Results

Eight 'Winter Arc' Rules That Will Actually Deliver Results

Tanggal: 04 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://lifehacker.com/health/best-winter-arc-rules-that-will-deliver-results?utm_medium=RSS

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there are a lot of terrible social media trends out there aimed at self-improvement, yet even though everybody has been making fun of the "winter arc" craze, i actually think it’s a good one. During your Winter Arc, you promise yourself you’ll stick to your fitness and self-care routines during (and despite) the end-of-year chaos. It's a good goal, with one caveat: Make sure you choose rules that will actually improve your life and deliver results.

Berdasarkan laporan, think of the “arc” in the sense of a “story arc. 1, but others start in early November, or whenever they get around to it. The most hardcore #gymtok-ers will tell you the Winter Arc officially begins on Oct. ” The Winter Arc is a self-improvement journey that unfolds over the last few months of the calendar year. The "when" isn't critical, though—whenever you read this is a fine time to start. The close of the Winter Arc is fixed, however: It ends Jan. 1, just as everybody who is less dedicated than you is waking from their holiday food comas and resolving to get in shape.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you get to choose your own terms for your winter arc. The general vibe is one of locking in, committing to your goals, and actually doing the things you’re always saying you’ll do. m. TikToker @carlyupgraded has said that her own mental image of someone nailing their Winter Arc is “hood up, headphones on, getting ready to go for a run in the rain at 5 a. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa it turns out i’ve accidentally been winter-arc-ing for years; i just didn’t know it had a catchy name. Why save your gym routine for New Year’s when you’ll have the place to yourself all December? We’re even gifted with an extra hour in the mornings to fill with something productive.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i really love the mindset shift involved. Commonly, people are active in the summer (great time for outdoor fun), may or may not stick with their routines in the fall, and let everything fall apart as the holidays approach. Who has time to go to the gym when you’re planning Thanksgiving, attending holiday parties, studying for final exams, or whatever else the end of the year throws in front of you?.

Berdasarkan laporan, but that’s the exact reason why this time of year is the best to start (or restart) a fitness routine, or really any kind of routine. And when the chaos clears on Jan. The gym routine you can stick with amid the chaos isn’t going to be one you drop after a few months. When you start a routine during a busy time of year, you’ll be forced to make it sustainable. You’re already training yourself to work around obstacles as they come up, which is a key component of self-efficacy. 1, your routine will be even easier to stick to.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, there are ways to lean in too hard: choosing unsustainable habits, falling for bad diet advice, mistaking not masturbating for some kind of health hack, the usual suspects. There’s also the pitfall of focusing too much on the vibes and too little on what you’re actually going to do or how you’ll benefit.

Diungkapkan bahwa and then there’s the framing: you were working on yourself all year, but you’re in danger of letting up on the gas, but you’re committed to locking in so that you’re a step ahead of everybody who takes this time to slack off. I really don’t love this tack. Self-improvement is not a competition. There’s a difference between being consistent in your training and healthy eating (good) and seeing the pursuit of health and fitness as something where you always have to work harder because you’re at risk of getting left behind.

Diungkapkan bahwa i also don’t love how gendered the winter arc tiktoks tend to be. These days, the focus is more on personal goal setting: Lots of the girlies filming their Winter Arc rules are doing so in a notebook and talking about journaling exercises that will help you identify what you need to work on to get to your "best self. ” When I first started looking at the Winter Arc trend a few years ago, the women’s versions were more likely to include restrictive dieting or to focus on how the Winter Arc will finally (sigh) snatch your waist. When you search for Winter Arc content, the first few suggestions include “winter arc for women” and “winter arc for men. " Sometimes this is all monetized; training plans and journaling prompts can, of course, be purchased at the link in bio.

Berdasarkan laporan, i do like that many of the women’s versions emphasize sustainability and setting your own goals rather than copying somebody else's. I don't love the enormity of the mental burden you're supposed to shoulder before even beginning. Should I really have to file an in-depth written report with myself before revamping every area of my life with a 100% commitment to multiple goals?.

Berdasarkan laporan, the men’s versions tend to go off the rails in another direction, with rules like “no girls” or “go ghost. Now the men's videos tend to be more vibes-based, featuring images of pre-dawn workouts and plates full of salad with motivational quotes playing in the background. When the men give their rules, they tend to be simpler than the women's—no journaling exercises—but they often boil down to the same overly strict routines. ” No distractions! Here, I've seen a shift over the years as well: at first there was overly serious content, followed quickly by satire (yelling at the viewer to get divorced and go work out in the dark). (And then, of course, they'll offer to sell you a 90-day or 60-day plan. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’re going to do a winter arc (or if you’re already doing one), make sure to structure it in a way that benefits you. Choosing 10 overly ambitious goals and setting yourself up for failure is not a healthy way to approach self-improvement, OK? Pick goals that are meaningful, achievable without divine intervention, and trackable with tools you already have at hand (for example, tracking your steps with a Fitbit or your running mileage with a Garmin watch).

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s also helpful to think of developing yourself over this arc, rather than taking it as a three-month (or two-month) challenge where you have to do everything right all the time. If you currently wake up at 8 a. tomorrow. m. m. , make that a habit, then try for 7:00 a. It’s OK to aim for 7:30 a. m. m. and want to wake up at 5 a. , you don’t have to set your alarm for 5 a. m. , and so on.

With that in mind, here are some "rules" I've seen from creators that I'm actually on board with (so long as you don't overwhelm yourself with them):.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wake up earlier. A great goal, especially if you take advantage of the time change to make things easier on your body.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, get to bed on time. Never a bad idea. Cultivating good sleep habits in general is always worthwhile.

Sebagaimana diketahui, get your steps in. Be thoughtful about what your target is: 10,000 is not for everybody. Better to choose a number that would be a modest improvement on what you already do.

Sebagaimana diketahui, exercise x times per week. Pick a number that works for you, and get into it. Be realistic about your goal, and for the best results, be consistent even if you’re sore at first.

Sebagaimana diketahui, eat healthy. You don’t need to cut out sugar or pretend that there’s something evil about seed oils. This is a great goal, with the major caveat that there are a lot of ways to eat healthy. Do get more protein and veggies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, be more thoughtful about using social media. I’m not going to tell you to delete all your apps (“except TikTok,” as the TikTokers say). But it’s fair to consider whether you might want to delete a few apps, turn off some notifications, or put your phone on Do Not Disturb for more hours of the day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, journal or read more. Reading can be entertainment or a great way to learn. Journaling can be great for working through your feelings or cultivating a creative habit. Choose whichever you need most.

Diungkapkan bahwa learn a new skill. I’ve mostly seen this one in the men’s TikToks, and I love it. Skills are, as I’ve noted, a multi-layered exercise for your brain. They’re often thinking of “skills” that will help in some kind of entrepreneurship grift they’re about to sell you, but there are tons of skills that will come in handy in life, or that are at least fun to learn. Practice a language, get better at cooking, make some art. And they may come in handy someday.

Berdasarkan laporan, this year i've slacked off on my fitness routine as i've gotten more involved in other hobbies, but i'm actually looking forward to being more consistent. (I'm even tracking the second one with a sticker chart. My winter goals include exercising early in the day when possible and reading 20 minutes each day. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i won’t be putting up my christmas tree just yet, but my home already looks festive thanks to my seasonal indoor plants. Aside from a pretty white cyclamen and bright red poinsettia, I also have a Christmas cactus.

Now that I have completed my winter houseplant collection, I’m wondering how I can help my Christmas cactus thrive and stay vibrant and healthy over the festive season and beyond.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it turns out there’s a natural fix, and it’s sitting in the compost caddy in my kitchen. Besides giving me a kick in the morning, coffee grounds are a natural fertilizer that can perk up your Christmas cactus.

Berdasarkan laporan, but before you start adding all your spent coffee grounds to your christmas cactus, take it easy. Although coffee grounds can be used as a mild fertilizer, there are other steps you can take to help your plant thrive.

What’s more, there are certain times of year when your Christmas cactus will appreciate a feed, and other times when it won’t.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the christmas cactus grows in tropical rainforests of brazil, and thrives in rich, organic compost, unlike the desert cacti that grow in arid, sandy ground. Coffee grounds can help mimic this rich environment, and their nitrogen content supports healthy new growth. They are also acidic, which this plant favors.

Beyond promoting lush growth, vibrant color and a strong root system, coffee grounds can enhance soil structure by improving aeration and water retention.

Beyond promoting lush growth, vibrant color and a strong root system, coffee grounds can enhance soil structure by improving aeration and water retention.

Diungkapkan bahwa although i’m happiest when i have a daily fix of coffee grounds, your christmas cactus won’t appreciate a daily sprinkle of grounds. In fact, it only needs a coffee fix every four to six weeks in the spring and summer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you add coffee grounds to your plant’s soil over the festive season, it can stress the plant during its flowering season. Instead of adding nutrients to the soil, the extra nitrogen can disrupt the plant’s cycle, preventing buds from forming or causing flowers to fall early.

It’s best to dry the coffee grounds first and mix them into the soil or another compost before adding them to your plant.

Berdasarkan laporan, wet coffee grounds sitting on top of the soil can develop white mold and attract fungus gnats; drying them first eliminates this risk. Wet grounds are also likely to clump together and form a dense layer on the surface, hindering aeration. While, fresh or uncomposted grounds break down more slowly and take longer to work.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this set of three ceramic planters features a reactive beige glaze and includes drainage holes and saucers. They are the ideal gift for the plant lover in your life. Berdasarkan laporan, 1. Once dry, mix 1 to 2 tablespoons of the grounds with 1 cup of potting soil. Coffee grounds and potting soilSpread used coffee grounds on a plate and let them dry completely. Spread the blend over the top of your plant’s soil, repeating every four to six weeks during the spring and summer.

Diungkapkan bahwa 2. Make a liquid feedMix 1 teaspoon of used coffee grounds into 1 cup of warm water and let the solution steep overnight. Strain out the grounds and use the coffee-infused water to feed your plant, repeating monthly during the spring and summer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 3. Once the compost has fully broken down and is ready to use, add a fresh layer to the top of your plant’s soil. Create a coffee compostAdd used coffee grounds to your compost bin. While it takes the longest to prepare, composting is the safest and most effective way to fertilize your Christmas cactus with coffee grounds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while it's best not to fertilize your christmas cactus during its flowering season, you can help it thrive by providing the best conditions. LightPlace your Christmas cactus in a bright spot, such as near a window, but keep it out of direct sunlight, as harsh rays can scorch, bleach or weaken the plant. Because these plants are native to tropical rainforests, they thrive best in dappled shade.

TemperatureAim to keep the room temperature around 65-75°F during the day, while a cooler nighttime temperature will help trigger blooming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, waterbecause it’s not a desert cactus, it needs to be watered, but don’t go overboard. I use a simple tool, like this Hathdia Soil Moisture Meter, $5 at Amazon, to check when my plants need a drink.

Five Creative Ways to Spend Your FSA Funds Before the End of the Year

Berdasarkan laporan, if you have a flexible spending account (fsa), you know the drill: use the funds before the end of the year, or lose them. Does that mean your hard-earned funds go to waste? Definitely not. You can spend your remaining FSA funds on other qualifying healthcare costs. Unfortunately, chances are slim you can pack the rest of the year with doctor's appointments. And what counts as "qualifying" might surprise you—for instance, you can use your FSA or HSA funds to get yourself a sweet new fitness tracker or smartwatch.

As the end of the year approaches, here are all the ways you can spend any leftover money in your FSA balance.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many over-the-counter medications and health items are fsa-eligible, including pain relievers, cold medicine, bandages, dental care products, menstrual products, and more. Scan your medicine cabinet and make a list of anything you need to stock up on.

FSA/HSA eligibility for smartwatches and other fitness wearables is real, but the main “catch" (as I’ve previously explained) is proving the device is in fact necessary, which requires you to obtain a Letter of Medical Necessity (LMN).

Diungkapkan bahwa screenless recovery trackers like whoop, amazfit helio strap, and the oura ring can usually be justified as hsa/fsa eligible around sleep quality, hrv-based stress monitoring, or recovery tracking tied to a chronic condition. For instance, Coros offers FSA/HSA eligibility for all its watches and heart rate monitors through its partnership with Truemed. Similarly, smartwatches can qualify the same way a basic tracker does, as long as you can link a relevant documented health concern. Amazfit similarly lets you filter by HSA/FSA eligibility for its smartwatches.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you want to get creative with it, the official fsa store lets you filter by "surprisingly eligible. 99, Supergoop! sunscreen for $38. 00, or perhaps a snazzy massage gun for $349. In the meantime, go crazy and snag yourself Epsom salt for $8. " Similar to the section above, for some of these items, you'll want to brush up on how exactly to get an LMN to justify certain tech as FSA-eligible for you personally. 99.

Diungkapkan bahwa knee braces, wrist splints, compression socks, and other orthopedic items can help relieve chronic pain issues. If you use eyeglasses or contacts, consider using your FSA dollars to update or refresh your prescriptions. Rather than wait for these issues to rear their heads down the line, use FSA money to offset the costs of these fixes now. Don't forget to stock up on eye drops and lens solution, too.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you have medical procedures scheduled for early next year, many healthcare providers will allow you to pre-pay the estimated costs this calendar year using fsa funds. This includes dental work, physical therapy, chiropractic visits, Lasik eye surgery, and more.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however you choose to spend your fsa funds, don’t let that money go to waste. After all, it came out of your paycheck. 31 this year, so you aren’t left forfeiting your hard-earned funds. Check in with your employer’s rules for any balance remaining on Dec. #605. I tested the Apple HomeView for a week — and I was expecting a lot more

📅 12 Nov 2026

I tested the Apple HomeView for a week — and I was expecting a lot more

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.tomsguide.com/home/smart-home/apple-homeview-review

Keep exploring and earning more as a member.

Unlock and manage exclusive Tom’s Guide member rewards.

Diungkapkan bahwa join the tom's guide club for quick access. Enter your email below and we'll send confirmation, and sign you up to our newsletter.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

The Apple HomeView is built well, but as a smart display, it can't do as much as rivals from Amazon, and Siri isn't as capable as other AI assistants.

No physical button to turn off camera or mic.

Fewer streaming apps than other smart displays.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why you can trust tom's guide our writers and editors spend hours analyzing and reviewing products, services, and apps to help find what's best for you. Find out more about how we test, analyze, and rate.

Diungkapkan bahwa after years of waiting, apple has finally come out with a smart display, but is it already too late? the apple homeview is a sleek device with a nice-looking interface, but scratch deeper than the surface, and you’ll find that it quickly comes up short against the best smart displays. Yes, Amazon’s are the only other game in town, but that company’s much longer history when designing a smart home device — and AI — shows just how far Apple needs to go.

Yes, there are some redeeming qualities of the HomeView — it’s great at music, and integrates well with your iPhone — but when testing it alongside an Amazon smart display, I was left wanting for features time and again.

A post shared by Tom's Guide (@tomsguide).

Berdasarkan laporan, the homeview goes on sale november 13, 2026, for $299. It comes in two versions, a freestanding model, and a wall-mounted version. The freestanding HomeView is offered in four colors (silver, starlight, rose pink, space gray) while the wall version comes in just silver or space gray.

If you opt for the wall-mounted version, you’ll have to pay an additional amount for either the USB-C wall connector ($59) or the hardwired mount ($79); if you choose the latter of these two, you’ll probably want to call an electrician to install it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the base of the homeview is a small aluminum cylinder that’s rounded at the top, where it connects to the display. The bottom of the base has several rows of perforated holes for the display's speaker.

In an era where most smart home speakers (Apple’s included) are using more fabric-covered finishes, the HomeView reminded me, more than anything, of the love child of a first-generation Amazon Echo and the iMac G4.

Berdasarkan laporan, the homeview’s screen is smaller than i would have imagined from the early videos and hands-ons. It definitely won’t take up a ton of room on your counter, which is a nice thing if you have limited space.

Get instant access to breaking news, the hottest reviews, great deals and helpful tips.

Diungkapkan bahwa apple’s specs say the display is 7 inches on the diagonal, but owing to the bezels, the usable space is about 6. 4 inches. Measuring vertically and horizontally, the screen is 4 7/8 inches in each direction.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s very nice to look at; its 1088-by-1088-pixel resolution (220 pixels per inch) made all of my photos look excellent, and the display can automatically adjust its brightness from 0. 3 to 500 nits.

Diungkapkan bahwa for a device that’s smaller than the homepod mini, the homeview does a pretty impressive job with music. Apple says that the HomeView has two custom full-range drivers and a custom down-firing woofer, which delivered stronger bass than I would have expected for a device this size.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i was able to blast the “hamilton” soundtrack throughout my kitchen, and it was loud enough that i had to turn down the volume. In order to do so, though, I had to either yell at Siri, or tap the screen; there’s no dedicated volume controls.

A 12MP camera with Center Stage sits at the very top center bezel; it was perfectly adequate when making FaceTime calls, and the Center Stage feature was welcome, as it let me move around my kitchen while chatting.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can set up the homeview with any number of faces. As a Peanuts fan, one of my favorites was an animated clock with Snoopy and Woodstock doing a bunch of shenanigans — and easily swipe between them. However, due to its size — or because of Apple’s design decisions — the HomeView’s homescreen feels more limited than Amazon’s.

Sebagaimana diketahui, here’s an example. Like the Echo Show devices, the HomeView has a face, called Home Modular, that lets you control smart home devices, and even get a live look from any cameras connected to Apple Home. However, if you want to see pictures of your kids, know what the weather is, and see what’s happening at your front door, good luck. You can create a custom Modular face that incorporates some of these elements, but you can't fit them all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by contrast, the echo show 8, which admittedly has a larger 8. 7-inch screen, lets you pack more on there, so you get a much more holistic look at everything going on both in and outside of your home.

Diungkapkan bahwa in order to simplify things for developers, the homeview uses the same widgets that you can install on an iphone. But what works for a smartphone doesn’t necessarily work for a smart display.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can add widgets to the homeview, but surprisingly — and somewhat aggravatingly — some of them don’t work, or aren’t optimized for the device. ” Same with the Anker Eufy app and YouTube. For example, I added the Disney+ widget, but when I tapped on it, it displayed a message saying “The Disney+ app is only available on iPhone. The only widget that lets you play videos natively is Apple TV.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even more frustrating for me was the photos widget. However, if you tap on the widget to change the image, you get a message saying “App unavailable. After setting it up — which requires you to use your iPhone to select the photos you want — the widget then displays a picture from your collection. The Photos app is only available on iPhone. ” I felt a bit like Charlie Brown right after Lucy swiped the football away.

Those widgets do serve a purpose — you can start playing a video on your iPhone, and then cast it to the HomeView, but it’s an extra step that you don’t need to take with any other smart display.

Diungkapkan bahwa what’s odd is that the homeview lists dozens of widgets, but few are optimized for the homeview. And, what Widgets are available aren’t that many. Perhaps this will change once the product goes on sale. While there’s a Stocks widget, there’s none for News or Sports, so you’ll have to ask Siri for updates on the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, forget using the homeview as a smart tv; while you can watch apple tv content, there aren’t any other widgets for most popular streaming services, such as hulu, peacock, or netflix. One of the main reasons I like smart displays is that they can act as mini TVs, so I can cook Sunday dinner in the kitchen, but still be able to watch football games without running into the living room.

In keeping with Apple’s admirable insistence on privacy — and because it’s a nice feature — the HomeView’s screen will only display personalized content if its camera recognizes that individual’s face.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, for example, if i walk up to the homeview, i’ll see my photos and calendar appointments, but if my wife were to approach the device, she would see her content, provided she were a registered user. In either instance, our iPhones would also have to be on the same Wi-Fi network for any personal content to appear.

Berdasarkan laporan, if the homeview recognizes your face, a small orange dot appears in the upper right corner. Curiously for a company which prides itself on privacy, there’s no button on the HomeView to disable its camera.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the reasons that the homeview was delayed was that apple was waiting for siri to get smarter. So, I put it to the test versus Alexa+ on an Echo Show 15. Tl;dr — Apple needs to do a bit more work.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first challenge was asking for the weather. The next time I asked, I got a slightly more detailed response: “Expect clear skies today with a high of 59 degrees and a low of 47 degrees. The first time I asked Siri, I received a very terse “Expect partly cloudy skies today,” and the HomeView’s screen changed to show me the current temperature. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by contrast, alexa+ was much more conversant. Today’s high is 61 with a low of 45, and it’ll stay breezy with decreasing clouds and no rain expected. “Right now it’s cloudy and 56 degrees, feeling 53. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa next, i asked both alexa+ and siri to look up local pizza places. Again, Siri gave me a list, but Alexa+ was more effusive, telling me how late some of the more popular restaurants were open.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i then asked both ais to order me a pizza from one particular restaurant. Siri couldn’t, but offered to place a call, but Alexa+ linked to Uber Eats, and walked me through ordering a large pie.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another key function for the homeview is that it can act as a central control panel for all of your smart home devices. Not only can you tap widgets on the screen to turn your lights on and off, but you can also use your voice to control things. For example, I said “Hey Siri, show me my video doorbell” and the HomeView brought up a live view of my front door nearly instantly.

Diungkapkan bahwa i also liked that you can add a widget to show a live view of your security cameras. I have a Eufy camera, which worked well with the HomeView, but this is one area where Apple needs to incentivize its partners a bit more; there are far fewer security cameras compatible with Apple Home than there are for Amazon and Google.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, how well can a home assistant get you where you need to go? i asked both siri and alexa+ to get me directions to newark airport. Siri gave its usual brief response: “It will take about 13 minutes to drive to Newark Liberty International Airport in light traffic. ” I then asked Siri to send the directions to my phone, which it did as a text message with a link to Apple Maps to my phone.

Diungkapkan bahwa alexa+ was more chatty, but less helpful. It’s about 12 minutes and 5 miles to Newark Liberty International Airport, with light traffic on I-78. “Navigation isn’t supported on this device, but I can give you the route info. ” I then asked Alexa to send the directions to my phone, but the best it could do was send a copy of the conversation to the Alexa app.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when i asked alexa+ to book me an uber ride, it went so far as to ask me if i wanted to start from my work or home location, and went through all the rest of the steps. The best Siri could do was offer to open the Uber app.

Berdasarkan laporan, one thing i did like is that siri can scan through your calendar and messages to surface things you might have missed, or forgot about. For example, I asked “what time are my neighbors having people over today?”.

Diungkapkan bahwa it then dug through all of my messages and replied “your neighbors are having people over for a fire today at 4:30 p. m. ” On the screen, it added further detail: “There will be drinks for the adults and marshmallows to roast for kids. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, historically, apple has generally not been first to any particular category, but when it enters a market — mp3 players, phones, tablets, etc. — it’s generally learned from the mistakes of the competition, and delivered a device that outshines everything else on the market.

Berdasarkan laporan, the homeview is not that. While the physical design of the device is lovely, its software does not live up to the same standard. It can do far less than rival smart displays from Amazon, and Siri is still a less capable home assistant AI than Alexa+ or Gemini.

I think Apple probably had to release it; there have been reports that the HomeView was languishing in a warehouse for the better part of a year, which makes sense considering it’s using the A18, rather than the A19 chip — but maybe it should have stayed there.
