Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, considering the amzchef espresso machine has a built-in grinder, i was extremely concerned when i unboxed two pressurized portafilter baskets. Pressurized portafilter baskets use two walls to force the espresso through a little hole, which creates fluffier crema but destroys delicate flavors. If you don’t know the difference between pressurized and non-pressurized baskets, I’ll give you a quick rundown. You should use pressurized portafilter baskets if you have pre-ground coffee or an inferior grinder (subtle foreshadowing).

Berdasarkan laporan, non-pressurized portafilter baskets have a mesh-like bottom, which allows the espresso to extract naturally, with no extra pressure — that all comes from the fineness of the grind. These baskets are a little trickier to use for beginners, but brew delicate, nuanced espresso if you have a good grinder and good beans.

Sebagaimana diketahui, so i was immediately suspicious when i saw the pressurized baskets. If I’m using a machine with a built-in grinder — ergo, freshly ground coffee — surely I should be provided non-pressurized baskets? A dual-walled basket will over-pressurize my espresso and mask delicate flavors.

Anyway, I had to use what Amzchef provided, so I, of course, tested it with said pressurized baskets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by default, the grinder grinds for 7 seconds. 3g of coffee during my tests, but obviously this will change if you grind finer or coarser for different beans. This resulted in 17. I set the grinder to click 5, as this pulled the ideal 1:2 ratio in 25-28 seconds.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, then, the machine automatically doses water. It pulled 35g of coffee in 28 seconds, which is almost the perfect 1:2 ratio in 25-28 seconds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, here’s a photo of said default shot. This is with zero customizations — straight from the machine’s brain.

Berdasarkan laporan, the crema is a little flat, and there’s not a whole lot of depth to the shot. As for the taste, it was a little bitter, not particularly strong or weak, but it got the job done. Sebagaimana diketahui, all of these features are excellent — i wouldn’t buy an espresso machine without — and resulted in decent espresso. Pressurized portafilters aside, this coffee sits firmly in the “good enough” category. Especially for $229, which is crazy cheap.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i have never seen a bean-to-cup semi-automatic espresso machine cheaper than the amzchef espresso machine with grinder. I’ve tested $350 models — the aforementioned Casabrews Marenza and Gevi Espresso Machine with Grinder — but $229? That’s crazy cheap.

As mentioned earlier, the grinder grinds for 7 seconds by default, which you can adjust. I’m looking for 100% pass-through. I used click 5 to test espresso, which extracted a 1:2 ratio in 28 seconds.

Berdasarkan laporan, here’s a photo to exemplify what i mean. The left is coffee bigger than 500 microns, and the right is coffee smaller than 500 microns (espresso size).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the steam wand is one of the biggest let-dows of the whole machine. It’s weak, spluttery, and takes over sixty seconds to steam a jug of milk (for one coffee).

Berdasarkan laporan, to activate the steam wand itself, you have to press the steam graphic on the screen, not twist the knob on the side. After pressing the graphic, and the machine reading 107 (temperature), then you twist the knob. It needs a few seconds to switch to steam.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the steam wand is really disappointing. I still managed to get half-decent latte art, but the actual texture of the milk was undesirable. It had a layer of foam on top and then wet milk — no velvety aeration throughout.

Berdasarkan laporan, as you can see, the latte art is still good. But this is after years of practice. I don’t think this is a good machine for beginners to learn on, because you have to know how to tease out “good” milk texture from a sub-par wand.

Diungkapkan bahwa i don’t really have anything positive to say about the steam wand. If you aren’t fussed about milk drinks, this might be something you can overlook, but for me, I live for decadent, velvety milk, so it’d be a pass.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as it’s just 13 inches wide and 13 inches deep, the amzchef espresso machine is relatively compact, especially for a bean-to-cup machine. If you’re seriously short on space (and budget), I might recommend the Amzchef, but that’s a might.

Berdasarkan laporan, the machine has an “aluminum alloy” boiler, which means it’s more susceptible to corrosion than a stainless steel boiler, however, there’s no water filter slot in the water tank. Either the machine won’t last as long as a stainless steel boiler, or you’ll need to be seriously on top of descaling — even if you live in a soft water area. There are also no cleaning discs or a cleaning portafilter basket cover for backflushing, unlike Breville and De’Longhi’s machines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, amzchef advertizes a 2-year warranty if you purchase from the amzchef website, but the espresso machine is $70 more expensive on the amzchef site (at time of writing — amzchef has told me it will correct this). If you register it, the warranty increases to three years. However, you have to spend an extra $70 buying it directly from Amzchef. On the Amzchef warranty page, it reads, “Buy from Amazon, Walmart, or other online retailers? You may get an up-to-2-year limited warranty. ” Schrödinger’s warranty!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, amzchef’s representative confirmed that you receive a 2-year warranty regardless of retailer, which is great news, but the language is still too opaque. What if you didn’t have a direct link to the company to find out this information (as I assume most of you won’t)? The language needs to be clearer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, opaque business practices like this make me incredibly wary about recommending a product. It’s disingenuous. I wouldn’t spend my hard-earned money at a company with obfuscated warranty rules.

Berdasarkan laporan, everything about the amzchef espresso machine feels too good to be true. The water tank is flimsy, the grinder hopper is flimsy, the portafilter is flimsy, and the steam wand grates as it moves. A PID controller, customizable brew temperature, built-in grinder, cold brew, and 360° swivel steam wand for $229? There’s something not quite right here — and you can feel it in the build quality. Not only that, but the steam wand is relatively weak, and the low-quality grinder makes for mediocre espresso.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is a tricky one, because $229 is incredibly cheap for an espresso machine with a grinder. Normally, you’d be expecting to pay $229 for the espresso machine alone and an extra $229 for the grinder — and that would be cheap.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, i can’t recommend this machine due to its low-quality build, low-quality accessories, and low-quality grinder. I would recommend grabbing the $350 Casabrews Marenza instead (but that’s also incredibly flimsy), or save up more for the Breville Barista Express — often around $499 during sales events like Black Friday — or the De’Longhi Arte Evo — also around $450 during sales events.

Berdasarkan laporan, erin bashford is a senior writer at tom's guide, focusing on reviews. She has a Masters in Broadcast and Digital Journalism from the University of East Anglia. In her spare time you can find her reading, practising yoga, writing, or stressing over today’s NYT Games.

Berdasarkan laporan, amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products amazon doesn’t sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to reuters. The project, called the “World Product Graph,” is meant to make it less likely that shoppers leave Amazon to do their product research on Reddit or Google, and make it more likely shoppers end up at Amazon even if they’re searching for a product sold elsewhere. The same goes for AI agents — if Amazon has the largest stockpile of shopping data, AI agents may rely on its index of products over others, so even people shopping with bots will end up on its pages.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, links to outside retailers’ products have already started popping up on amazon through the “shop direct” feature it launched last year. According to Reuters, an internal Amazon document on the project says “Many Rufus answers are factually wrong or incomplete” and running users’ Amazon searches with the AI is expensive. The World Product Graph project would also be aimed at fixing issues with the AI by providing it more data. The company also has its own AI shopping assistant, Alexa for Shopping, previously called Rufus. Adding more data is reportedly supposed to make the system more accurate and able to use cheaper models.

Sebagaimana diketahui, whether this actually ships is still up in the air. The internal document reportedly says the project “depends on discovering how brands organize their products on their own websites,” which could involve Amazon crawling other retailers’ sites. Reuters says it’s unclear “if or when this plan may be implemented,” but said the document on it included an October 1st, 2027 release date.

Sebagaimana diketahui, amazon said in a statement to reuters that “draft, outdated documents often paint an incomplete picture and the existence of a brainstorming document such as this one doesn’t necessarily reflect our current plans. ”.

#811. Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday

📅 14 Nov 2026

Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/11/starship-flight-15-powers-to-orbit-setting-up-a-possible-catch-on-saturday/

One way or another, the company will get some more data on Saturday.

STARBASE, Texas—Starship lifted off right on schedule Friday from South Texas, making its 15th test flight in more than three years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the largely successful launch took place in the early evening; as the massive rocket rose into the atmosphere, the sun sank toward the western horizon. The weather in South Texas is not always comfortable; summers are long and hot. Conditions were ideal for the launch, with the atmospheric winds so calm the rocket’s white plume did not dissipate for many minutes. Friday evening was perfect at Starbase.

Diungkapkan bahwa the first stage ascended toward space flawlessly, releasing the upper stage above the gulf of mexico. From there, the Starship upper stage ignited its Raptor engines and powered its way into a nominal orbit. This was the second time SpaceX has flown Starship into low-Earth orbit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when it came time for the first stage to return to the ground, it dropped like a rock. However, due to an unspecified issue, the vehicle was commanded to divert into the Gulf rather than return to the Starbase facility to be caught by the launch tower. It created a fantastically powerful explosion, even for observers more than 10 miles away.

Berdasarkan laporan, the primary aim of friday’s launch was the deployment of 26 starlink v3 satellites from a narrow door at the base of the spacecraft. This occurred about 40 minutes into Starship’s flight, and all 26 satellites—which have solar panels that stretch 60 meters end to end when fully deployed—safely made it into orbit, where they will now use onboard propulsion to raise their altitude.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this means that starship is now an operational, orbital rocket. It is the largest and most powerful machine humans have ever launched into space. The challenge for the company now is to make Starship reusable and dramatically increase its flight rate.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in that sense, the first part of friday’s mission was not a success. SpaceX had hoped to return the first-stage booster, refurbish it, and fly it again. The company has previously landed and reflown Starship boosters but has yet to do so with the latest iteration of the vehicle, version 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, spacex still has a chance to make history on saturday with the potential return of the starship upper stage. SpaceX has never attempted to catch the vehicle’s upper stage.

Berdasarkan laporan, doing so will require starship to pass a series of tests in orbit and subsequently during its return to earth to ensure it is fully healthy. This is critical because Starship will be passing over parts of Mexico and the United States before returning to Starbase, and SpaceX does not want to endanger people on the ground. Additionally, it does not want to risk damage to its launch towers.

Berdasarkan laporan, if starship passes these health checks, it would land at about 3:15 pm local time in texas (21:15 utc). If it does not, the company has earlier options to de-orbit the vehicle into an ocean.

Sebagaimana diketahui, successfully returning starship’s upper stage would be historic, as well as significant for spacex’s efforts to reuse the massive rocket. It would also give the company valuable information about the vehicle’s performance during reentry.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the biggest hurdles left in starship’s development is the vehicle’s heat shield, which must protect the upper stage during its return through earth’s atmosphere. More than that, SpaceX aims to make Starship rapidly reusable, and to do this, Starship’s tiles must be light and resilient.

Sebagaimana diketahui, spacex has been experimenting with tiles since the beginning of the starship program, trying to find the right combination of low mass, heat resistance, and durability so the tiles require minimal refurbishment between launches. For this flight, SpaceX said it is applying learnings from the previous test flight in September, including additional retention mechanisms on tiles in areas deemed to be at the highest risk of falling off during ascent and addressing areas with a flow path for plasma to get behind the tiles.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another problem on recent flights has been heat incursion into the small gaps between the edges of the tiles. According to SpaceX, this Starship has a large portion of the heat shield equipped with a curved tile design that has shown the ability to reduce heating in the gaps between tiles.

After all, you don’t need to know everything, only what’s important.

Tech > Gaming > Gaming Hardware > Gaming Accessories.

The Soma Pro and Some Sense HD Haptics are part of an updated vibrating gaming chair lineup promising better immersion and improved comfort.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are different levels of gaming immersion when it comes to haptics. On one side, you have controller haptics, which provide a bit of stimulation in games. There’s usually a nice little rumble from explosions or gunshots, and maybe a bit of vibration to give you some feedback while driving off-road.

Diungkapkan bahwa on the other side, you have razer’s two new gaming chairs, the $1,000 soma pro and the $570 soma sense hd haptics, which feature some serious motors to really shake your spine. Both incorporate Razer Sensa HD Haptics, which the company first debuted as part of Project Esther back in 2024. There’s also THX Spatial Audio support and Razer Chroma RGB lighting built-in.

Berdasarkan laporan, this isn’t an entirely new line for razer. The Soma Chroma was the first wireless RGB gaming chair announced this summer for $499. The Soma series is one the company has been working on for some years now. Now Razer is rounding out its gaming chair lineup.

Berdasarkan laporan, “the soma pro is where the chair finally joins the game,” said addie tan, razer’s global head of its lifestyle division in a press statement. With Soma Pro, the chair becomes part of the game — you feel it, hear it and see it. “For years, gamers have upgraded everything they see and hear, while the seat they spend every session in stayed on the sidelines. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both chairs come with six haptic motor actuators built into each seat, unlike the $300 razer freyja, which was essentially a wired cushion you placed on top of your existing chair and plugged in. I actually owned the Freyja, and while it worked OK for some games, for a lot of others I tried it with, it just used a generic rumble without really customizing things. It was also very uncomfortable to sit on long-term, didn’t like the feeling of being tethered to a cable and ended up getting rid of it. A built-in wireless option, like these new chairs, seems like a much better solution to me.

Sebagaimana diketahui, both new chairs deliver “multizone feedback” via razer sensa hd haptics, and razer says they should match the intensity, direction, and distance of in-game events. For example, an explosion off to the side will feel different from one that’s up close to you. So this isn’t just a generic rumble that applies to every situation; it’s customized based on the gameplay.

Sebagaimana diketahui, razer lists more than 100 pc games that support integrated sensa hd haptics, including battlefield 6, borderlands 4, marvel rivals and s. T. A. 2: Heart of Chornobyl. K. R. L. E. For everything else, the chairs use Audio-to-Haptics via Razer Synapse, converting audio into vibration, so the effect also works with games without native support, as well as with movies and music.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in theory, this should allow the feature to work on anything that supports controller vibration, but a razer representative did not immediately respond to a request for clarification. On the Soma Pro, you can dial the overall intensity up or down in Synapse, or adjust each of the six motor zones individually.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s worth noting that, unlike the freyja, both chairs are wireless, though that doesn’t mean they’re completely untethered since razer hasn’t managed to break the laws of energy yet. Neither a power bank nor a power adapter is included in the box, so budget for one if you want the cable-free look. Each chair draws power over a single USB-C connection, from either a wall outlet or a compatible power bank, to preserve what Razer calls a wireless-aesthetic setup. That’s a downside because my LiberNovo Omni chair, which comes with adjustable lumbar support, a motorized spine, and even a massager setting, shipped with a rechargeable 2,200-mAh power bank.

Both chairs carry a three-year warranty on mechanisms and moving parts and a two-year warranty on electronic parts.

Diungkapkan bahwa both soma chairs share the same hardware, at least where you rest your backside. There’s a built-in lumbar arch intended to encourage a neutral sitting position, a dual-density cold-cured foam seat cushion with a softer top layer over a firmer core, and a backrest that reclines up to 132 degrees. Both have a steel frame and are rated for people up to 331 pounds. Razer lists the Soma Pro for people 5 feet, 5 inches to 6 feet, 6 inches tall, and the Sensa model for 5 feet, 3 inches to 6 feet, 6 inches.

Diungkapkan bahwa for $1,000, the soma pro offers sound and light in addition to haptics. You can use them on their own, or pair them with front speakers to widen the soundstage, with the chair effectively handling the rear of the setup. Yes, that’s right: you don’t need computer speakers; they’re right behind your head now. Built-in speakers deliver THX Spatial Audio directly from the chair. It is the same idea Razer has used with Razer Clio headrest speakers before, now integrated rather than clipped on.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the pro is also the only model in the line with razer chroma rgb. The reactive lighting uses 16. While I love a good light show, this isn’t really meant for the person seated in the chair. 8 million colors, responds to on-screen action in more than 300 integrated games, and syncs with the rest of a Razer setup via Synapse. It seems designed for streamers and people watching you, since it doesn’t look like you can really see the light show unless you take your eyes off the stream.

The Pro also gets the line’s most adjustable fit: 4D armrests, a magnetic head cushion and a frog tilt mechanism, on a powder-coated aluminum alloy wheelbase.

Diungkapkan bahwa the controls are on a built-in panel that switches between razer hyperspeed wireless (2. 4 GHz) for PC and Bluetooth LE for mobile, with a companion Razer Furniture app on the Pro for adjusting haptics, audio and lighting from a phone. The controls are a nice alternative to using Razer’s annoyingly overlapping and often invasive Synapse and Chroma software.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the $570 soma sensa hd haptics chair keeps the same six-actuator haptic system and drops the speakers and the rgb. That makes it $70 more than the lighting-only Soma Chroma ($499), and $430 less than the Soma Pro ($1,000). If you already have a headset or speakers, which I’d assume you do as a gamer who’s considering a product like this, the Soma Sensa HD Haptics gets you most of the key features without the unnecessary extras.

#814. ‘We need more reviewers’: Finding Linux bugs is easy now – fixing them is another story

📅 13 Nov 2026

‘We need more reviewers’: Finding Linux bugs is easy now – fixing them is another story

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/ai-bug-reports-linux-windows/

Our gifting experts are obsessively searching for holiday gifts that are unique, thoughtful and suitable for any budget.

Some Linux maintainers are quitting under the crushing strain of AI bug reports, while others see signs for hope.

Berdasarkan laporan, recently, microsoft’s forge lab reported that its ai scanning system, mdash, turned up 59 upstream linux kernel bug reports, including one flaw at least 21 years old. That’s less impressive than it sounds. For 2026, through Nov. 2, the Linux Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) team reported an average of 27 CVEs a day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, why so many? easy: in linux, any bug can be a security bug. As Linux Torvalds told me in 2024, “Bugs will happen, and anything can be a security bug if somebody is clever enough to just figure out how to abuse it. ” Besides, since Linux runs everything from smartphones to refrigerators to supercomputers, what may be a serious bug in one device may not even appear at all on another.

Berdasarkan laporan, it’s not just linux, though. In the latest Windows Patch Tuesday security release, Microsoft reported 726 CVEs. The vast majority of these bug reports are coming from AI programmers. Finding bugs on anything is no longer the hard part. But reviewing and fixing them is, and both Microsoft developers and kernel maintainers are struggling to keep up.

Also: Microsoft fixes over 1,000 Windows flaws – and one is being exploited.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the forge lab said, “finding bugs and fixing them are drastically out of balance. ” Turning its findings into reports took more than four person-months because “human effort [is] the bottleneck. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s hurting the overworked maintainers. 10, an ARM engineer and Linux kernel maintainer Lorenzo Stoakes gave up reviewing code. On Nov. Stoakes, a kernel contributor since 2014,  wrote, “Given the current throughput in the kernel resulting from AI-generated series, I unfortunately lack the bandwidth to generally be able to offer review except in those areas I maintain. He’d been a reviewer for the memory-management core, misc, reclaim, and Rust-related sections. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, stoakes added, “of course the ai wave has been horrible, and is getting significantly worse. Then it was at least once a week. Nowadays it’s pretty much half of what I see, if not more. At first it was once in a while that I’d see slop. Then every few days. ”.

Also: Filing bugs for open-source apps is a huge help for devs – and easier than you think.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he’s not alone. We need more reviewers. All of the maintainers are burnt out, and we have been for ten years. As Greg Kroah-Hartman, the Linux kernel stable maintainer, said in a Q&A session at Open Source Summit Europe, “We don’t have enough people to review them, the onslaught of the LLM-generated patches. We don’t have enough. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s not all doom and gloom, though. 4 rc 2 “was driven by various AI fixes. Linux Torvalds, Linux’s creator, said in a recent Linux Kernel Mailing List (LKML) message that much of the new code in the Linux 7. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa he continued, “that on the bpf [berkeley packet filter]- side at least the fixes are now coming in faster than the new reports, and that sounds lovely if true. I think most other areas haven’t reached that point yet, but it’s at least a sign that we _may_ be starting to see the tide starting to turn. Don’t hold your breath, but maybe cross your fingers we’ll be getting there in the not entirely distant future. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa we can but hope. In an interview, Kroah-Hartman isn’t so optimistic. “We are getting closer, yes, but not quite there yet. ”  He’s not even willing to give a guesstimate of when human-approved AI fixes will catch up with and overcome AI bug reports.

Also: I locked down my OpenClaw agent with Claude Code – then dared it to escape.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, daniel steinberg, the creator of the open-source curl project, is also cautiously optimistic. Steinberg, who’s been especially critical of AI slop bug reports, told me in an interview that he now believes “we manage the flood pretty well so far, even if it goes a little up and down in periods depending exactly on who sends us a new set of findings this particular week. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, still, while ai bugs remain a major headache for now, ai bug fixes, along with the work of thousands of maintainers, may finally be starting to stem the ai bug flood. I still foresee long days and nights of work ahead.

Berdasarkan laporan, i also expect we’ll see more serious security breaches. In November alone, we saw a serious Linux TCP networking security hole revealed; the nasty Alpine Linux OpenSSH flaw; Alpine’s GitLab near-miss; and the wide-open PHP2Shell security problem, which many groups still haven’t patched.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, everything is a service now, and a lot of people are hitting the point where one more monthly charge is one too many on principle alone. Diungkapkan bahwa apple gives you 5 gb of icloud for free, which stops being enough about a week after you buy an iphone. The irony is that they launched with 5 GB of free storage in 2011, and it’s almost laughable that it hasn’t been increased since.

The 2 TB Lifetime plan is a one-time payment that costs less than four years of iCloud+ at the same size, and the day you buy it is the last day you pay anything for it.

Berdasarkan laporan, pcloud has offered lifetime plans for 9 years and now 24 million people use it, and it’s run by a swiss company under swiss privacy law. The “what if they go away” question is fair for any lifetime offer, and a company with that track record is the best answer you’re going to get.

If you’ve been paying for iCloud or Google Drive storage for all of your files for the last 9 years instead of using pCloud, go do the math on how much you’ve spent.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple charges a lot to move from a 256 gb macbook air to a 512 gb one, and you can’t change your mind later with a hard drive upgrade. pCloud Drive is your solution without breaking the bank. It’s a native Mac app that mounts your pCloud storage as a drive in Finder, so your files appear as if they’re natively on your Mac but live in the cloud until you open them. Storage has gotten incredibly pricey in recent years as well. A 256 GB laptop with a 2 TB pCloud Drive behind it stops feeling small. It runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android, and everything stays in sync across all of them in real time.

Diungkapkan bahwa with pcloud backup, backing up the folders you choose is easy and safe from a lost laptop, fire, flood, or theft. If you run a NAS at home, pCloud supports backing it up via WebDAV, Rsync, SFTP, and SCP, making it a real offsite destination for a Synology NAS, not just a simple sync folder. It would be a perfect offsite backup for small businesses, remote workers, etc.

Diungkapkan bahwa icloud photos is great, but it uses storage from your icloud storage quota, which can get expensive as apple’s cameras get better and better and file sizes keep increasing. Every pCloud plan includes pCloud Photos, a photo gallery that organizes everything by date on a timeline, automatically tags objects and scenes, and groups shots into albums by event and person.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the pcloud mobile app backs up your camera roll automatically to free up space on your iphone; a memories feature resurfaces older photos, as the photos app does; and a built-in document scanner turns receipts and paperwork into pdfs without needing a separate app. Inside the app, there is also a built-in Photo Editor with crop, rotate, brightness, contrast, highlights, shadows, and eight one-click filters, so quick fixes don’t require moving it back to Apple Photos.

Sebagaimana diketahui, pcloud docs covers documents, spreadsheets, presentations, pdfs, text, and markdown with six built-in editors and real-time collaboration, all from the browser or the mobile app. If your household is split, with one person on Microsoft, Apple, or Google, pCloud can pull in files from Google Photos, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, and Facebook. That’s the easiest way I’ve seen to get everyone’s files into one place without needing to download and reupload everything.

Berdasarkan laporan, files and photos aren’t the only benefit of joining the pcloud ecosystem. Passwords are still hard, and most people are either paying monthly for a manager or reusing the same three passwords. pCloud Pass is a password manager that works across all devices, browsers, and operating systems, with one-click login, form filling, and a generator for strong, unique passwords. A lifetime license solves the annoying aspects of using a dedicated password manager app or being locked into Apple’s or Google’s systems.

Diungkapkan bahwa pcloud encryption is client-side, zero-knowledge encryption for your most sensitive files. In plain language: files in your Crypto folder are encrypted on your Mac before they upload, and only you hold the key. pCloud can’t read them, and neither can anyone else. It’s the right place for tax returns, scans of your birth certificate, and anything else you’d rather not have sitting in a regular sync folder.

Diungkapkan bahwa here’s the deal you’ll want to pay the most attention to: pcloud offers an exclusive 3in1 bundle, because it knocks out two more subscriptions at once. Count up what this level of storage and functionality would cost you over three or four years, and you’ll see how incredible of a deal it is. It’s 3 TB of Lifetime storage plus Lifetime pCloud Pass and Lifetime pCloud Encryption, and it’s the only offer that includes everything you need to ditch a vast majority of your subscriptions. If you don’t sign up today, you’ll end up regretting it in 2030.

Diungkapkan bahwa pcloud’s black friday pricing runs from november 13 through november 28. Every plan is a one-time payment with Lifetime access, no subscription, and no renewal.

Berdasarkan laporan, you also get to choose where your data is stored, with data centers in luxembourg and the united states, and everything is protected in transit with tls/ssl. With pCloud, it’s your files and your rules, and one Lifetime deal protects everything.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you’re tired of paying for storage every month, this is the week to stop. Grab pCloud’s Black Friday Lifetime deal before it ends on November 28.

#817. The FAA Nationwide Ground Stop Is Over

📅 14 Nov 2026

The FAA Nationwide Ground Stop Is Over

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/the-faa-nationwide-ground-stop-is-over/

Sebagaimana diketahui, instability in a system that allows communications between the federal aviation administration, air traffic controllers, and pilots was responsible for the country’s most disastrous nationwide ground stop in air traffic since september 11. The ground stop lasted five hours.

Berdasarkan laporan, several outlets reported that a failure in the faa telecommunications infrastructure or fti network, was linked to the faa’s decision to declare a ground stop. It will also be equipped to more easily handle newer aircraft, including drones, electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft (eVTOLs), and other “air taxis. The FAA has said the update will reduce outages and outage-related delays, and make the system safer. The FTI is the private communications backbone for the air traffic control system. The system is in the midst of a major, multi-year modernization project, which involves replacing a decades-old network of copper wire with high-speed fiber-optic cables. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, at the time the ground stop was lifted on friday evening, over 6,300 flights within, into, or out of the us had been canceled, according to the aviation tech company flightaware; 9,500 had been delayed. Freight and mail flights have also been affected. It will likely take days, if not weeks, for airlines to reposition aircraft and crew and get their schedules back on track.

Diungkapkan bahwa delays will continue, us transportation secretary sean duffy said in a friday evening briefing at the white house. “It will take us some time to unwind what has happened. ” He blamed “old switches, old routers” and a “data overload” for the communications systems failure. He said a “legacy system”—likely referring to FTI—was involved.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the issue was caused by “putting patches into the system” as new equipment was being installed, us department of homeland security secretary markwayne mullin said at the white house briefing. “The new technology was overwhelming the older system,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mullin said there were no indications that the outage was related to a cyberattack, but “there’s not complete certainty right now. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the system is managed by the government contractor l3harris technologies. On its website, L3Harris says that its “team’s deep knowledge of the US national airspace allows us to upgrade systems without disrupting air traffic operations. ” A spokesperson for the company did not respond to a request for comment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in may, l3harris said it had completed 50 percent of its modernization project. Seventy percent of FAA sites have been upgraded to fiber, the company said earlier this month. The Trump Administration has said it aims to overhaul the nation's Air Traffic Control System by the end of 2028.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in august, the faa tapped at&t to upgrade the fti, the private faa communication network, to an entirely new system. Previously, Verizon had been selected to build and operate this new system. That contract is worth $73 million, though its worth is likely to climb into the billions over the years. L2Harris is meant to operate the legacy system until the upgrades are in place.

Diungkapkan bahwa earlier friday, before the ground stop, us transportation secretary sean duffy sent a letter to congressional leaders asking them to approve his department’s request for $30. 1 billion in funding to further upgrade the air traffic control system, and to improve airports. On Friday, he upped the ask: “I want $50 billion,” he said during a briefing at the White House.

Berdasarkan laporan, a september report published by the us government accountability office (gao) raised concerns that the faa’s attempt to accelerate long-delayed modernization plans “could be prioritizing speed over costs and air traffic disruption. ” It found that the FAA does not have a “well-documented” lifecycle cost estimate for its programs, and that, rather than a master schedule guiding the sprawling project, has 11,389 schedules that are not integrated.

#818. Moon phase today: What the Moon will look like on November 14, 2026

📅 14 Nov 2026

Moon phase today: What the Moon will look like on November 14, 2026

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/science/moon-phase-today-nov-14-2026

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the moon is getting a little bit bigger each night as we work through the lunar phases. We're still in the Waxing Crescent phase, which means more of the Moon is becoming illuminated each evening as it makes its way towards the First Quarter.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as of saturday, nov. 14, the NASA's Daily Moon Guide tracker tells us the Moon is in the Waxing Crescent phase, with 22% of its surface visible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you don't have any visual aids, you can see see some features on the moon's surface tonight, specifically the mare crisium and the mare fecunditatis. With binoculars or a telescope, you'll also see the Endymion Crater.

The next Full Moon will take place on November 24.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the moon takes approximately 29. 5 days to complete one full cycle. As it orbits Earth, the amount of sunlight reflecting off its surface that we can see changes, creating the different phases. This takes us from the New Moon to the Full Moon and back again, before the cycle begins once more, according to NASA.

New Moon - The Moon is between Earth and the sun, so the side we see is dark (in other words, it's invisible to the eye).

Waxing Crescent - A small sliver of light appears on the right side (Northern Hemisphere).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, first quarter - half of the moon is lit on the right side. It looks like a half-Moon.

Waxing Gibbous - More than half is lit up, but it's not quite full yet.

Full Moon - The whole face of the Moon is illuminated and fully visible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, waning gibbous - the moon starts losing light on the right side. (Northern Hemisphere).

Third Quarter (or Last Quarter) - Another half-Moon, but now the left side is lit.

Waning Crescent - A thin sliver of light remains on the left side before going dark again.

Thinking about a new smart TV? Give this free AI setup a try first, it could give yours an upgrade.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there's nothing more frustrating than a smart tv that takes forever to load an app, gets bogged down by menus or constantly recommends shows you have no interest in watching. And if your TV still has a perfectly good picture, replacing it just because the software feels outdated seems like a waste of money.

But what if you could give your existing TV a refresh without spending anything?.

Berdasarkan laporan, a free ai setup could help you clean up unnecessary apps, simplify your home screen and adjust settings that might be slowing things down. Better yet, it runs locally on your computer, so you don't need another subscription or a cloud-based AI assistant.

Diungkapkan bahwa by using a local ai agent, you can manage a smart tv over your home network. It isn't quite as simple as installing an app, and the results will depend on your television. But if you're comfortable following a few technical steps, it could be an interesting way to get more life out of a TV you already own.

The setup uses three free tools: Ollama, Hermes Agent and an AI model from the Qwen3 family.

Berdasarkan laporan, ollama runs the ai model directly on your computer, while hermes agent acts as the assistant that carries out your instructions. Think of it this way, instead of asking a chatbot for advice and manually following its recommendations, you're asking an AI agent to inspect your TV and potentially make approved changes for you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, you could ask it to identify apps you no longer use, turn off unnecessary animations that randomly come on, or help simplify your home screen. The goal is to reduce clutter and potentially improve responsiveness, although there's no guarantee that these changes will make every TV noticeably faster.

Berdasarkan laporan, sign up to the tom's ai guide weekly newsletter summing up all the biggest ai news you need to know. Plus, analysis from our AI editors and tips on how to use the latest AI tools!.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest advantage is that the ai itself can operate without sending requests to a cloud service. Once the software and model have been downloaded, you can run the setup on your own hardware without paying per prompt.

Before jumping in, you'll need a computer capable of running a local AI model and a compatible smart TV connected to the same home network.

Android TV and Google TV are the most straightforward candidates for the original workflow because they support Android Debug Bridge, or ADB, which lets a computer communicate with the television.

Sebagaimana diketahui, lg tvs running webos also have developer tools, but they use a different connection process. Samsung's mainstream smart TVs generally run Tizen, so you shouldn't follow Android TV instructions on a Samsung set.

Here's the basic process for a compatible Android TV or Google TV.

Open your TV's Settings menu and look for the device information section, usually under System or About.

Find the Android TV OS build number and select it repeatedly, typically seven times, until developer options become available.

Sebagaimana diketahui, next, look for debugging settings. Depending on your TV's software version, you may be able to enable wireless debugging and pair your computer over Wi-Fi.

Some older televisions require a different ADB connection method, so check the instructions for your specific model before proceeding.

Sebagaimana diketahui, open your television's network settings and locate its ip address. You'll need this so your computer knows which device to connect to.

Make sure your computer and TV are connected to the same trusted home network.

Diungkapkan bahwa visit ollama's website and install the version for your computer. The original tutorial uses a model from the Qwen3 family.

For example, you can download and run Qwen3 8B by entering the following command in your computer's terminal: ollama run qwen3:8b.

Berdasarkan laporan, keep in mind that running ai locally requires processing power and memory. If you're using an older computer, a smaller compatible model may be more practical, although its ability to follow complex instructions could be limited.

Next, install Hermes Agent and configure it to use your locally running model.

Berdasarkan laporan, hermes is the software that translates your requests into actions. The model decides what to do, while the agent uses the tools available on your computer to perform those tasks.

Berdasarkan laporan, you'll also need to establish and authorize the connection between your computer and television. Simply entering the TV's IP address isn't enough on devices that require ADB pairing or other authentication.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this is where the fun begins. AI engineer and YouTube creator Fahd Mirza, who demonstrated how to use a free, locally running AI agent to manage an older smart TV, has shared a free prompt on GitHub designed to help the agent inspect and clean up an Android TV.

The prompt instructs the agent to check available memory, identify installed apps and separate them into categories based on whether they're needed.

It also asks the AI to get your permission before changing anything, disable apps rather than uninstall them and keep a record of changes so they can be reversed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of the more ambitious instructions asks the agent to build a simplified home screen without ads or unwanted recommendations. Full transparency, I wasn't able to pull that one off, but if you have tried and it worked for you, please let me know in the comments. That's an interesting possibility, but it should be treated as an experimental request rather than a guaranteed feature. Just start with something simple and reversible, such as asking the agent to report available memory without making any changes.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most appealing thing about this approach is that it gives you another option before replacing a television that's otherwise working fine. There's also a privacy benefit. Since the AI model runs locally, your prompts don't have to be processed by a cloud AI provider. That doesn't mean your smart TV stops collecting data through its own apps and services, however.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are some important downsides. Disabling the wrong system app could cause problems, while a factory reset may erase your settings and require you to sign in to your streaming services again. Developer settings can give software powerful access to your television, and an AI agent can make mistakes even when you've instructed it to ask permission first. Not a big deal, but as someone who can never remember passwords, it's a frustration I felt was worth mentioning.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it's also worth remembering that removing apps or changing animations won't fix every performance problem. A TV with an aging processor or limited memory will still have those hardware limitations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for most people, this isn't going to be easier than using the settings menu or connecting an inexpensive streaming stick. But if you enjoy experimenting with AI and want more control over a television you already own, it could help you get a little more mileage out of your current setup.

Quadruped rainbows target multiple muscle groups efficiently.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Most of us don’t have hours to devote to working out, so when there’s an exercise that can strengthen multiple muscle groups at the same time, I’m quick to use with my personal training clients.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, quadruped rainbows are one such exercise. This no-equipment move targets the glutes, hamstrings, hips, deep core, and even the shoulder stabilizing muscles, making it a great option when time is limited. The standard version is appropriate for beginners, but there are plenty of ways to up the challenge level if you’re more advanced.

Roll out your yoga mat and give quadruped rainbows a try during your next workout.

Sebagaimana diketahui, before trying any new exercise, be sure to check in with your doctor first. They may recommend avoiding certain movements based on your health background.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beginners should consider working with a certified personal trainer to learn how to do quadruped rainbows properly. A trainer can also provide modifications if needed and progression options when you’re ready. Doing any exercise with poor form can lead to pain or injury.

Aside from a yoga mat, those with sore knees may want to use a pillow or a rolled-up towel for additional cushioning.

Berdasarkan laporan, start with one set of 10 reps on each side. Gradually increase your reps to 12 on each side and add an additional set. Eventually, you’ll aim for 3 sets of 15 reps on each side.

Get instant access to breaking news, the hottest reviews, great deals and helpful tips.

Diungkapkan bahwa do quadruped rainbows 2-3 times a week at first, then work your way up to 3-4 times per week. The exercise can be done on its own, as a part of another workout, or as a warm-up for more intense exercise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you should feel muscle fatigue but never sharp pain when doing this exercise. Stop the exercise and consult your physician if you feel sharp pain at any point.

This exercise works the glutes, hip abductors, hip adductors, hamstrings, deep core muscles like the rectus abdominis and internal obliques, and rotator cuff muscles.

Berdasarkan laporan, the arc-like movement of the leg promotes optimal hip mobility and range of motion. In the quadruped position, your deep core works to stabilize your entire body as the active leg moves into each position.

Additionally, quadruped rainbows don’t require any equipment and are accessible for a wide range of fitness levels and abilities.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you’ve just started to work out regularly, you may find it difficult to keep proper form during this exercise. The biggest form compensations I see are rotating the hips side to side as you move the leg back and forth, excessive arching in the lower back, and sinking the chest towards the floor.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you notice any of these compensations, it may indicate some deep core weakness. In addition to including exercises like diaphragmatic breathing, planks, and hollow holds in your routine, you may also want to modify the quadruped rainbow.

Sebagaimana diketahui, instead of sweeping your leg to the side in a semi-circular motion, try simply lifting the active leg. Aim to bring the knee and ankle in line with the hips. Hold briefly, and then lower the toe back towards the floor.

Berdasarkan laporan, you can also practice donkey kicks in preparation for the standard quadruped rainbow. Keep the active leg bent at a 90-degree angle, then kick the heel towards the ceiling. Pause briefly, then lower the active leg back to the starting position.

Diungkapkan bahwa as you get stronger and more conditioned, quadruped rainbows may not challenge you like it did at first. The easiest way to increase the challenge is to add reps and sets.

Berdasarkan laporan, that being said, sometimes doing more than 15 reps of an exercise can get rather monotonous. Wearing ankle weights is another easy way to up the ante, as is performing the exercise on an unstable surface like a balance pad or Bosu ball. Just be sure your form stays solid throughout the exercise.

#828. FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later

📅 14 Nov 2026

FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/faa-orders-nationwide-ground-stop-departing-flights-reasons-safety-rcna609247

BREAKING: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins the Alaska governor’s race.

Sebagaimana diketahui, u. S. air traffic was brought to a standstill Friday after the Federal Aviation Administration ordered a nationwide ground stop for departing flights that lasted more than five hours.

Berdasarkan laporan, the faa lifted the ground stop at 8:15 p. m. ET, after more than 7,000 flights were canceled and airports across the country became packed with stranded, irritated passengers.

Diungkapkan bahwa the sudden and stunning alert was issued at 3:54 p. It offered no other information beyond stating that “all departing traffic should remain ground stopped until further notice. m. ET, “due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety,” the FAA said. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hours later, transportation secretary sean duffy, in a white house news conference friday evening, blamed the outage on an outdated air traffic control system in which the routers “got overloaded with data. ”.

By Friday evening, Delta Air Lines, United, American said they were resuming flights.

Sebagaimana diketahui, duffy explained that once the routers became overloaded, it led to “instability for our radar and our communications in our centers, in our tracons throughout the country. ”.

TRACON stands for Terminal Radar Approach Control and is an air traffic control center.

“The TRACONS and the centers, we started to have inconsistency in the data from the radars and our communication with airplanes,” Duffy said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that instability was detected at 3:36 p. m. , he said.

Duffy said the FAA did not lose all telecom or radar capabilities but because of the instability, the ground stop was issued as a cautionary measure.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’ll take time for the airspace to recover from the ground stop as crews and planes are out of place and staffers may have reached on-duty shift limitations. However, Duffy said he anticipates American airspace will catch up before Thanksgiving travel rush.

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there was no sign of a cyberattack and the public was never in danger.

Berdasarkan laporan, “faa was able to handle it. We did it out of an abundance of caution,” he said in a news conference from the White House Friday night. Earlier on Friday, he described the issue as a telecommunications outage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the time of the ground stop, there were over 3,500 airplanes in the air, duffy said. When the FAA issued the alert, 4,042 flights headed for U. S. destinations were airborne, according to Flightradar24, a Swedish service that displays real-time aircraft flight tracking information.

Friday’s ground stop is perhaps the most severe consequence of what Duffy described as a decades-old air traffic control system using analog equipment, which has led to several issues and outages over the past few years.

In May 2025, radar screens at Newark Liberty International Airport’s went black during a 90-second outage.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, duffy said the legacy equipment will continue to fail and pushed congress to approve $50 billion to overhaul the system. Congress last year approved $12. 5 billion over five years to upgrade air traffic control, Reuters reported.

Mullin said earlier Friday that President Donald Trump was briefed on the ground stop.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mullin said though authorities cannot rule out a cyberattack, there was no evidence to suggest that. “There’s nothing completely certain right now. It doesn’t appear that way,” he said.

Meanwhile, Air Space Intelligence, the AI tech startup that is a vendor for the FAA on its new SMART system for air traffic control, insisted its software was not responsible for the nationwide ground stop.

“The current ground stop is not based on or a result of the SMART system, any product of ASI or our integration with FAA and ATC,” the company said in a statement posted to X.

Duffy said the SMART system is “completely disconnected” from the equipment that suffered issues Friday.

Several hours after the ground stop was announced, a top aviation expert estimated that anywhere from 300,000 to 400,000 passengers were stranded — and it was anybody’s guess when they would get to their destinations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “daily, we have about 25,000 flights in u. S. domestic markets,” Vikrant Vaze, a Dartmouth professor who specializes in commercial aviation logistics, wrote in an email to NBC News. “I would say we should have around 3,000 to 4,000 flights held up at this time over the past 2 plus hours. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but by 6 p. m. , Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Virginia, was at capacity, and Chicago O’Hare International Airport was nearing capacity, meaning there was no place for the planes to park, a source with knowledge told NBC News.

With planes stranded on runways, the likelihood increased that some of these planes would have to be diverted to other airports, the source said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, aviation safety expert jeff guzzetti called the outage “extraordinary. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, guzzetti emphasized that pilots are trained to operate through communications outages and that there are redundancies in place for such instances. Pilots “could get information relayed through other means” to ensure planes are spaced properly for landing.

Diungkapkan bahwa there are different layers of communications — high-altitude, midlevel and the towers on the ground. The high-altitude control centers are the ones affected by the outage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at newark liberty international airport, personnel in the control tower said the situation is “a whole mess right now,” according to liveatc. “We’re running out of space” and “there’s significant gate issues” were comments also heard on the live audio feed.

Berdasarkan laporan, “i’m as much in the dark as everyone else. I’m not getting any information from anybody,” one controller at Newark said, according to the feed.

Shortly before the FAA issued its alert, both major airports in Chicago — O’Hare and Midway International Airport — were listed on a ground stop alert due to an “equipment outage,” NBC Chicago reported.

Deveren Werne was on an American Airlines jet that was about to take off from Indianapolis to Chicago when suddenly the pilots announced that all flights were grounded.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “at first, the pilot announced that there was some kind of radio issue,” werne, 55, of greenville, south carolina, told nbc news in a telephone interview. “Then a little while later, the pilot said something like, ‘There is something going on that’s more serious than that. ’”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, werne, a consultant who helps manufacturers and other industries adapt ai technology, said he is a frequent flyer and this was a first for him. He said there was “a mixture of emotions” from his fellow passengers on hearing the announcement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “then i started hearing from other friends who were on planes, including one in chicago who was stuck on a runway,” werne said. “Right now, our plane is heading back to the terminal, so at least we’re going to be able to deplane. ”.

Medical flights, such as for organ transplants, were not stopped during the ground stop, Duffy said.

Diungkapkan bahwa ground stops across the nation are a rarity in u. S. history.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after the sept. 11, 2001, terrorist attacks, the FAA ordered an unprecedented nationwide ground stop. All civilian air traffic across U. S. airspace was halted and airborne planes were ordered to land at the nearest available airports.

In January 2023, the FAA grounded all flights for a few hours, blaming a failure in the Notice to Air Missions system, which alerts pilots to a host of potential dangers.

Diungkapkan bahwa officials at the time blamed contract personnel for the outage, saying they accidentally deleted files while working to correct the synchronization between databases. The error prompted a computer outage that lasted approximately an hour and a half, Department of Transportation officials said at the time.

#832. What Happened to 3Com?

📅 12 Nov 2026

What Happened to 3Com?

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://dfarq.homeip.net/what-happened-to-3com/

Diungkapkan bahwa david l. Farquhar on technology old and new, computer security, and more.

Home » Retro Computing » What happened to 3Com?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, 3com was a high flying maker of network cards and other network equipment. And then they disappeared with a whimper on November 11, 2009. What happened to 3Com?.

Diungkapkan bahwa around the time of the dotcom boom, 3com was a 5. And for the next two decades, they were the go-to brand for network cards. 8 billion dollar company. They were founded in 1979 by Bob Metcalfe, the co-inventor of Ethernet. While the 3C501 network card is notoriously bad, their other cards from the 1980s and 1990s are very well regarded, and always were.

Berdasarkan laporan, they cost more, but had good driver support, the hardware worked reliably, and they were a known quantity. And 3Com made them in the United States, which was becoming unusual even in the 1990s.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i once worked in a shop that didn’t allow network equipment unless it was one of three brands. There was a saying in the 1980s that no one got fired for buying IBM. 3Com was one of them, along with Cisco and Intel. If you plugged a no name NE2000 clone card into the network and had problems, the IT department would replace the card and bill your department. When it came to networking, one could say the same for 3Com, during their prime.

Berdasarkan laporan, and they were huge. In 1995, 3Com bought the naming rights to Candlestick Park, the legendary baseball/football stadium in San Francisco. It held those rights until 2002.

Diungkapkan bahwa but after the dotcom bust, 3com faded away. What happened to 3Com, ultimately, was a series of bad decisions that led to a loss of profitability. Some of them may have made sense at the time. But not all of them.

Berdasarkan laporan, the first thing that happened was 3com walked away from its enterprise networking equipment business. Revenue dropped, and 3Com angered its customers and dealers. Admittedly Cisco was hard to compete with. But 3Com was the only brand succeeding at doing it. The logic behind the move always puzzled analysts, because it didn’t save any money. It’s likely many started buying Intel cards afterward, since they had to change vendors anyway.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many corporations like to buy multiple things from a single supplier. One could commend 3Com for not wanting to exploit that misunderstanding. Interoperability was the whole idea behind Ethernet, but not everyone understood that. The computers weren’t profitable, but they made it easier to sell services, and the services were profitable. This was one reason IBM stayed in the PC business for several years into the 21st century even though they were losing money on it. There is always the fear that two vendors will point fingers at each other, saying the network problem was caused by the hub and the network card being mismatched brands. But it came at a financial cost.

Berdasarkan laporan, it also didn’t help that the company branched into other businesses outside its core. For a short time, that was big business. The purchase of US Robotics was a key example. US Robotics made modems and Palm Pilots. But 3Com paid a premium price for products with a limited shelf life left in them.

Berdasarkan laporan, nothing good happened to 3com after that. The profitability of selling network adapters dropped. And by the time 3Com realized they needed to get back into network equipment, it was an expensive proposition. It took 3 years for Cisco to go from being 90% the size of 3Com to double the size of 3Com. From 2000 to 2005, the company didn’t turn a profit.

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, 3com failed because it was too dependent on network cards. Network cards accounted for about half their revenue during their bust years. And their cards were expensive. Intel undercut their price to try to gain market share, and they succeeded.

Diungkapkan bahwa and then they did exactly the wrong thing. It was the late ’90s, and they bought their way into the modem business. The dial-up modem business. Yet 3Com had no plan to get into that business. At that point in time, everyone knew broadband was the future, they just didn’t know exactly when it was going to arrive. It was like betting on AOL even though they were in the position to know the future belonged to AT&T.

Sebagaimana diketahui, making matters worse, minimum viable product-style modems undercut us robotics modems, just like the network card business. Not that Intel cards were a minimum viable product. But pretty much any ’90s network card not made by Intel or 3Com was.

Sebagaimana diketahui, 3com sought partnerships, most notably a partnership with chinese networking giant huawei. And 3Com started making product overseas as a cost reducing measure. There were even rumors of Huawei buying 3com, though that deal never went through. But ultimately, nothing could make up for all that lost time and all those bad decisions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so what happened to 3com? 3com didn’t go out of business and they didn’t sell out to huawei. They got Compaqed. Hewlett-Packard paid 2. Hewlett-Packard bought them out, which seems to be where every great ’90s technology company went to die. 7 billion dollars in late 2009 for 3Com’s assets.

Berdasarkan laporan, hp still sells network equipment like switches, routers, and access points. So HP gets in the door for one of those reasons, and when their network equipment turns out to be no worse than Cisco equipment, they stay with it. But they’re not as big of a name in networking as 3Com had been. HP will usually beat Cisco’s price. If they put a brand on it other than HP, it’s the newer Aruba brand, not 3Com. And if the IT department is under pressure to reduce the number of vendors it buys from, HP sells more things than Cisco. This makes them attractive to executives or purchasing agents looking to cut costs, consolidate vendors, or both. The selling point is the price being lower than Cisco. And the 3Com pedigree isn’t the selling point. At least until Dell comes around offering discounts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the network cards are long gone. When you buy an HP branded network card today, guess what it is? It’s an Intel card with HP’s logo engraved on it. Unless HP is trying to control costs, in which case it just has a sticker.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, vintage 3com network cards are very popular with retro computing enthusiasts. It had top-tier name recognition in the 80s and 90s. All but their very earliest cards generally have good driver support, work well, and are easier to configure than most of the cheaper competitors.

Berdasarkan laporan, my favorite retro network card is a very specific intel card, but if you need a card for anything from the 286 to the pentium ii era, you can do far worse than a 3com 3c509 isa card or 3c905 pci card. It’s absolutely period correct and absolutely something a knowledgeable professional would have used at the time. I have better luck with the ISA cards under DOS than the PCI cards, so if I want to run DOS and do any networking, I use a 3c509 ISA card in the system. But for Windows 95 and newer, the 3c905 PCI card works really well and is very cheap and common.

Sebagaimana diketahui, david farquhar is a computer security professional, entrepreneur, and author. He holds Security+ and CISSP certifications. He has written professionally about computers since 1991, so he was writing about retro computers when they were still new. He has been working in IT professionally since 1994 and has specialized in vulnerability management since 2013. Today he blogs five times a week, mostly about retro computers and retro gaming covering the time period from 1975 to 2000.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the 3c509 is something i remember, we swapped from wd cards to 3com when they became a ‘thing’. I also remember visiting their place at Bayfront in the valley a few times, as ultimately Apricot repackaged 3C cards, quite openly as, echoing what you say, people like a one-stop-shop. The other nail in the coffin was the invention by Microsoft of the Network Device Interface Specification (NDIS) which meant that any network stack could talk to any card as long as they had a working NDIS driver. This removed the stickiness of finely tuned stack software, which previously had entirely proprietary interfaces. The final nail was the incorporation of ethernet silicon in the main processor silicon, all you needed then was a physical circuit and job done.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the best network card in the 90’s wasn’t 3com or intel… it was dec’s tulip chipset. The chipset licensed to 3rd parties, in particular I remember buying a ton of Linksys LNE100TX cards based on it, which were rock solid. Able to have multiple MAC addresses simultaneously, it was the go-to for those who needed to run VRRP and other network HA methods. I see plenty on ebay.

#835. Elephants found to be increasingly isolated leading to fractured social networks

📅 14 Nov 2026

Elephants found to be increasingly isolated leading to fractured social networks

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://today.ucsd.edu/story/elephants-found-to-be-increasingly-isolated-leading-to-fractured-social-networks

With a troubling decline in the population, researchers warn of a tipping point for the highly social animals.

Berdasarkan laporan, humans and many other social animals thrive in well-established community networks. Asian elephants are one example of a species that flourishes in groups that work together to access food and care for their young, among other social bonds.

Berdasarkan laporan, university of california san diego scientists in the school of biological sciences studying the intricacies of asian elephant community structures have documented a troubling downturn in the population of the animals resulting in fractured social communities. Their study is published on the cover of the November 12 issue of Science.

Analyzing the social dynamics of more than 440 wild female Asian elephants over 12 years at the Udawalawe National Park in Sri Lanka, the researchers studied key shifts in the demographics of the elephants that seemed to trigger social communities becoming smaller and more isolated.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we found that gradual accumulation of losses from turnover preceded sudden change in the social networks among females in a wild population of asian elephants,” the researchers explained in the study, which was led by postdoctoral researcher anastasia madsen from the laboratory of associate professor shermin de silva in the department of ecology, behavior and evolution. de Silva also serves as president and founder of the conservation nonprofit Trunks & Leaves Inc.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the researchers’ analysis indicates a social structure tipping point. As the number of elephants in the population decreased over time, due to a combination of likely deaths, permanent emigrations of elephants and fewer incoming individuals, the population as a whole appears to have crossed a critical threshold that resulted in a shift from large, densely connected social communities, to smaller and less-connected social groupings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, asian elephants thrive in groups that work together to access food and care for their young. Credit: Udawalawe Elephant Research Project, CC BY-ND.

Berdasarkan laporan, “we see individual elephants leaving and possibly dying at accelerating rates, but new individuals are not coming into the population,” said madsen. However, the remaining elephants are also changing their relationships with each other. “With fewer individuals in the population, those who are left will naturally have fewer relationships. ”.

This new dynamic is a cause for concern, says Madsen, since the animals leverage their social groups and connections to forage, acquire information and raise young.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we can probably all relate to the feeling of social isolation brought about, paradoxically, with the advent of digital communications that seem to remove the physical constraints of needing to be in the same place at the same time,” said de silva. “But for many social species, which includes ourselves as much as elephants, we have to remember that social connectivity is very much a matter of sharing space and building relationships throughout our lives. Crucially, in order to have resilient communities, we need to be able to replace the relationships that are lost over time. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, many elephant populations are already impacted through deaths resulting from poaching and conflicts with humans. Other contributing factors may be disruptions in habitat connectivity and less food available for the elephants as ecological conditions change across the 119-square-mile park and surroundings.

The new social fracturing structure observed by the scientists may not be easily repaired, the researchers warn.

Diungkapkan bahwa “in general, we need to be more aware of these types of tipping points where we see sudden shifts after changes have been slowly building up,” said madsen. “Once we move past the tipping point, it’s much harder to go back to previous states. ”.

Credit: Udawalawe Elephant Research Project, CC BY-ND.

Berdasarkan laporan, the new findings will serve future studies seeking to understand shifts in animal society structures, how to detect such tranformations and the factors responsible for vulnerabilities. The study also stimulates ongoing discussions for conserving elephant populations as humans expand into areas where elephants historically thrived.

“We are gaining more evidence that studying social patterns is an important tool for us to see when things are going wrong in natural populations and, hopefully, to be able to do something about it,” said Madsen.

Berdasarkan laporan, the researchers of the study were: anastasia e. Sameera Weerathunga, Devaka K. Pushpakumara, U. V. Madsen, T. Weerakoon and Shermin de Silva.

Berdasarkan laporan, funding for the research was provided by the u. S. Fish and Wildlife Asian Elephant Conservation Grants (F11AP00258, F14AP00256 and F17AP00308); National Science Foundation (grant DBI-2305860); University of Pennsylvania; UC San Diego; and Trunks & Leaves Inc.

#838. How Not to Build a Music Player

📅 13 Nov 2026

How Not to Build a Music Player

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://alichraghi.github.io/blog/how-not-to-build-a-music-player/

The Twelve-Day War made me realize online music players aren’t a viable option for those who live under an oppressive regime that disconnects the internet across the country as a way to silence public opinion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, as soon as the connection came back, i started archiving tracks and looking for offline alternatives and discovered strawberry. It’s a feature-rich music player and kept me happy for quite a while, but I have this habit of looking at song lyrics and singing along! Strawberry fetches lyrics from the internet when it recognizes a song, but sometimes the lyrics weren’t line-synced and worse, it displayed the timestamps next to the lyrics which I found pretty annoying to look at. I wasn’t aware of other music players such as foobar2000 which my friend just pointed me to while writing this post.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i decided to write my own music player and call it amp with a few goals in mind: minimal feature-set, no c++ dependencies, proper system integration to make it feel like a native app, and of course, write it in zig (including the shaders!). I also wanted to roll my own UI because of the fun memories of working on V’s UI during my first days of being introduced into system programming. But before I could make any meaningful progress, a new wave of protests started. Following the tragedy of January 8 and 9, another internet blackout began, lasting more than four months.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during the blackout, there were these anonymous people on telegram selling internet access through personal white sims, whitelisted servers, starlink dishes, etc. A black market had formed for the freaking internet! You’d get charged $5 or more for just 1GB of traffic. The regime surely made a lot of money out of it. I ended up spending hundreds of dollars on these services and other methods just to stay in touch with my friends and keep my hobbies alive. Killing time was becoming a problem. The prices dropped slightly after a while, but it was still hella expensive. Especially for someone like me who built their entire social life online.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i carefully used this slow connection to download repositories, documention, etc. to continue working on my music player. It really brought me immense joy during this hard time.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, once the connection was mostly restored to the pre-blackout days (udp traffic is still blocked, though, which naturally also affects quic), my attention was shifted towards llms. So I decided to give it a try and experiment on my music player. They are still everywhere in the news, and I was just reminded that I owned a Claude Max 20x subscription gift from my boss back in 2025. It was a very addictive experience. It had become very hard for me to ignore the hype and progress around frontier LLMs. Eating dust and maybe soon expiring. As I really never thought about using them seriously for coding. I literally couldn’t hit the plan limits no matter how hard I tried, so after a few non-stop days of prompting, a good chunk of AMP was vibecoded.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the time, i thought this was an okay approach for a hobby project and i could just un-slopify it later. Going with the former option, I started reading every single line of code, rewriting them. I was surprised by my own ignorance and how much LLMs like to complicate stuff. Shortly after, Anthropic figured that I live in Iran and instantly banned my account. Then Codeberg announced its no-AI policy, which gave me two choices. Either get rid of all that slop or move the repository elsewhere. Little did I know I’m mentally incapable of reviewing tens of thousands lines of code. (I wish I could show an example, but my memory is extremely fragile and I’ve got no pre-rewrite history of the repo to check).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, four months later, nearly half the codebase is gone, and somehow it’s more robust with the same set of features (and more). For now and hopefully forever I think I’ll be going the old school way. That said I think it’s still possible to create a healthy relationship with LLMs as long as you look at them as a fancy IDE feature. A lot of times they are just running long sed or regex commands that are a no-brainer act for humans when done by hand but still consumes a good time. I regret relying on LLMs in the first place, but hey, lesson learned. Never rush your hobbies!.

Btw this is how AMP looks like right now!.

Worth mentioning that the blur shader is written in Zig based on this excellent blog post!.

#839. Philip Roth and David Remnick getting personal (2001)

Philip Roth and David Remnick getting personal (2001)

Berdasarkan laporan, in 2003, philip roth turned 70, a strange age for an enfant terrible. Roth’s work deepened. Slowly, improbably, that changed. Awards piled up. Respectability—the fate of all successful rebels—followed. To his early admirers, Roth meant chutzpah, rude energy, sly comic mischief. By 2003, Roth had come full circle: The rebel was revered; the iconoclast, an icon.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and so, celebrations were planned, tributes drafted. Generally, Roth shunned interviews—he preferred silence, exile, and cunning—but this time, he welcomed a BBC camera crew to his spare, wood-paneled studio (“where I really wish I lived,” he once said). Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at first, roth had misgivings. He resisted attempts to wrest control of his story. He disliked—really, scorned—literary journalism. A part of him favored seclusion. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the result, published in may 2000, was a remarkable snapshot, shrewd, revealing, yet somewhat mythopoetic. It nimbly avoided Roth’s divorces, his troubled friendships, but didn’t skirt Roth’s depressions and physical breakdowns.

Diungkapkan bahwa roth is no longer the wunderkind; he is sixty-seven, and the books reflect it. His voice isstill charged,anendlesslypliable instrument of comedy and impersonation, but that voice has also darkened, its comedy is deeper, the story it tells is more tragic and painful.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, how common were remnick’s mistakes? extremely common. A profile is, in a sense, a first draft, subject to later revision by scholars.
